prompt: Solutions to address traffic and environmental issues
essay:
Traffic and pollution-related issues have been cited as one of the most complicated issues that require governments to impose strict measures to address. While it is believed that stimulating the influx of rural citizens to the innermost metropolitan areas is the ultimate solution to tackle the described problems above, I completely disagree with this view. 
 On the one hand, the mentioned scheme above will deteriorate the existing gridlocked rush-hours traffic and pollution-related problems. Indeed, immigration will contribute to explosive growth in the number of city dwellers whose private cars will exert severe pressure on road capacity. Take Bangkok as a prime example, the year-on-year soar in the number of cars stemmed from immigrated rural citizens is exacerbating bottlenecks in the city centre, which forms a lengthy queue of cars at peak hours. Additionally, the migration of rural people to urban areas will exert detrimental impacts on the environment, especially air quality. The demand for car ownership of these people will put air quality at high risks of being severely polluted since the fossil fuels burning of private cars is likely to worsen air pollution, the main contributor to climate change. 
 On the other hand, motivating rural citizens to urban areas might urge the government to embark on different schemes to enhance traffic infrastructure. In practice, yearly road expansion projects are implemented in developing countries to alleviate traffic congestion as well as traffic collisions triggered by the excessive increase in the number of suburbs citizens whose private cars will overwhelm road capacity. In tandem with this, the government might encourage commuters to use public transports, including sky trains and underground trains once immigration is encouraged, which will mitigate air pollution. 
 In conclusion, I am not in favour of stimulating people from the countryside as well as suburbs to the innermost urban areas to tackle traffic and pollution-related problems though this scheme might bring about several advantages.
feedback:
The essay addresses the topic of whether stimulating rural citizens to move to inner metropolitan areas is a viable solution for traffic and pollution issues, taking a stance against it. However, there are several areas where improvements could significantly enhance the essay's effectiveness, clarity, and adherence to the requirements of an English proficiency test. 

Firstly, the introduction needs to directly state the reasons for disagreeing with the posed solution right after presenting the opinion. This approach would provide a clearer roadmap for the reader, making it evident from the beginning why the author believes stimulating rural migration is not an effective measure. Incorporating a brief mention of these reasons in the opening would ensure a more cohesive essay structure, with each paragraph then expanding on those initial points.

It's crucial to focus solely on supporting the chosen stance throughout the essay to maintain coherence and relevancy to the prompt. This means avoiding the introduction of comparative or contrasting views that don't directly reinforce the initial argument. The inclusion of such perspectives may lead to deductions in scoring, as it can be perceived as straying from the central thesis. Keeping each paragraph focused on a single reason also helps in maintaining a coherent argumentation line, essential for a higher score.

Moreover, the essay contains instances of long sentences that merge multiple ideas, potentially confusing readers and detracting from the overall clarity. Breaking down these complex sentences into simpler, more focused statements would greatly improve readability and coherence. Aim for a balanced paragraph structure with 3-5 sentences, each elucidating a single idea or argument. This not only enhances the essay's clarity but also makes it easier for readers to follow the author's line of thinking.

Stylistic and grammatical choices also need attention. Simplifying language not only ensures the essay is accessible but also minimizes the risk of errors that can obscure meaning or distract from the core arguments. By adhering to these suggestions—clarifying the introduction, focusing on supporting the essay's primary viewpoint, simplifying complex sentences, and refining grammar and style—the essay will become a more compelling, coherent, and persuasive piece of writing that better fulfills the objectives of an English proficiency assessment.

prompt: In the modern world, it is no longer necessary to use animal as food or to use animal products
essay:
Some body said:" Nowadays, we are living in high-tech century and due to that killing animals for food or to produce goods is not a necessity in our life". I am completely agree with this opinion and have no doubt about that. 
 In this day and age, as the result of science development and the creative of chefs, citizens now can eat beef without killing any cow or ox. According to the famous food magazine of Viet Nam, in Australia, people are eating meat which has origin from potatoes. That female chef investigate about how vegetarians keep continue eating vegetables without depressed about the taste in a long time. And finally she found out that they adulterate the meat by mixing potatoes and proteins synthesized from plants. What a great science achievement in cooking industry. Now the community of vegetarians can eat steak like other odirnary people. 
 In today modern society, there are not difficult to find a person who only eats vegetables or plants product in their meal. At the present, we can calculate the nutritions in our foods and people find out that vegetables can provide us the nutritions as good as meat or even better. In some sports, there are athlete or gymer only consume vitamins and essential subtances included in plants. And doctors did some experiments on them, they informed that the fat percentage in the vegetarians blood is lower than meat-consumers. 
 To sum up, with the improvement of present society, using animal as a meat production tools is not the vital problem in our life anymore. We can use vegetables as the alternative nutritions provider and look forward to the healthy and balance lifestyle.
feedback:
Your essay addresses the topic, which is the increasing irrelevance of using animals for food or goods in modern society. However, there are several areas that require attention to enhance clarity, accuracy, and coherence.

1. **Topic Response**: Your opening statement clearly aligns with the topic. However, you should aim to restate the topic in more general terms before diving into your argument. This approach helps to set the stage for your discussion.

2. **Clarity and Accuracy**: There are instances where the intended message gets lost due to unclear or incorrect language use. For example:
   - The phrase "creative of chefs" should be corrected to "creativeness of chefs" to accurately convey your meaning. "Creative" describes someone who can create, whereas "creativeness" refers to the quality or ability to create. 
   - The idea that vegetarians might eat meat adulterated with potatoes and plant proteins might confuse readers, as it contradicts the fundamental definition of vegetarianism. Vegetarians do not consume meat, so any reference suggesting otherwise must be carefully rephrased or clarified. A better approach might be to discuss how advancements in food technology, like plant-based meat alternatives, allow vegetarians and vegans to enjoy similar flavors and textures without consuming animal products.

3. **Coherence and Organization**: Your essay's flow is hindered by the abrupt introduction of examples and concepts without proper explanation. Each paragraph should logically follow from the one before, with clear connections between your main points. Avoid introducing new ideas without fully explaining their relevance or how they support your argument.

4. **Citing Sources**: While your mention of a food magazine from Vietnam attempts to provide evidence, academic writing requires careful citation of sources. Avoid presenting specific examples or data without proper attributions, as this can undermine the credibility of your argument. It's more effective to generalize information unless you can accurately cite a source.

5. **Stylistic Issues**: Pay attention to spelling, grammar, and punctuation errors. These mistakes can distract readers and make your essay harder to understand. For instance, "I am completely agree" should be "I completely agree," and "some body" should be "somebody" or "someone."

6. **Argument Development**: Your essay would benefit from a clearer development of arguments. Each paragraph should introduce a point that supports your overall thesis. Remember to start with a topic sentence, provide evidence or reasoning, and conclude with a statement that ties the paragraph's main idea back to your thesis.

7. **Contradictions**: Ensure that your arguments do not contradict each other. For consistent reasoning, every part of your essay should logically support your stance on the topic.

To improve your essay, focus on refining your arguments, using accurate and clear language, and organizing your thoughts coherently. Ensuring each point is well-supported and directly relevant to your thesis will also strengthen your essay.

prompt: IELTS writing 2 - Topic: pros and cons of public transport
essay:
These days, people tend to commute in public transport more frequently. it is common to see buses or subways everywhere, especially in big city. However, using public transport can bring both pros and cons for us. In this essay, I will discuss why public transport is so popular and some negatives of using it. 
 I will start by looking at the advantages of the mass transit. The biggest positives of using public transport is that we can decrease the amount of fuel used for travelling. Instead of using car individually, we can go to work by bus or subway with other people. By doing this, we probably save a lot of fossil fuel, which may slow down the progress of climate change. Another major advantage is that the traffic jam will be minimize due to public transport. If more people travel by bus and subway, the number of cars will be decreased. Thus the traffic congestion is less likely to happen. 
 On the other hand, public transport also has negative effects. One of the main disadvantages is the lack of privacy. Subway and bus are often very crowded. You may have to sit next to many strangers uncomfortably for almost thirty minutes or more. Another drawback is that it is hard to take a bus or metro in the rush hour as there will be a lot of people. We may waste so much time and miss our favourite television programme. 
 Both sides considered, using mass transit have both ups and downs. While commuting in subway can lower our fuel consumption and prevent gridlock, many people find it uncomfortable to wait and sit in a packed train. 
 (277 words)
feedback:
The essay you've written aims to discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using public transport. However, there's an important aspect to consider in order to make sure your essay exactly meets the requirements of the topic. The assignment asks for the pros and cons of using public transport, but your introduction slightly shifts the focus to the popularity of public transport and its negative aspects. This change shifts away from the specific “pros and cons” discussion. It's crucial to stay directly on topic to meet the expectations fully.

Regarding spelling, grammar, and style, there are a few areas to watch out for:

1. Always start sentences with a capital letter, such as in "it is common to see buses..." which should be "It is common to see buses..."
2. Watch out for singular and plural consistency ("big city" should be "big cities" to match the plural context).
3. Use articles correctly ("Using car individually" could be improved to "Using a car individually").
4. The phrase "traffic jam will be minimize" should be corrected to "traffic jam will be minimized" to maintain correct verb tense.
5. Remember, consistency in terminology is also vital; choose between 'public transport' and 'mass transit' and use it consistently throughout your essay.

Your point of view becomes clear through the discussion of both positives and negatives related to public transport. However, ensuring the reasons for your perspective are directly linked to the prompt will strengthen the clarity of your argument.

When presenting arguments, you've provided clear examples such as the reduction of fuel consumption and the decrease in traffic congestion as advantages, contrasted with the lack of privacy and the difficulties in rush hour as disadvantages. These points are well-chosen, but to deepen your essay, consider adding more detailed explanations or examples to fully illustrate your argument. For instance, how does saving fossil fuels specifically slow climate change, or in what ways might waiting or sitting in a crowded train affect people personally and broadly?

By closely adhering to the assignment's requirements, addressing the minor grammar and stylistic notes, and further developing your arguments with specific details, you can significantly enhance the quality and impact of your essays.

prompt: Convenient foods will replace traditional foods in the future... you agree or disagree?

 Nowadays, it is indubitable that the inhabitants are so busy with their work, as a result, they do not have enough time to cook at home.  Despite the benefit of these items, traditional foods still be the best choice for me to have the atmosphere of a family reunion after hard-working days. Traditional foods not only be a meal but also bringing the symbol of the culture of a particular area, when you travel to a destination the thing that you want to try first will be foods. Each region will have their own kinds of food to use in different holiday, anniversary.... For instance, in Viet Nam culture in Tet holiday our parents will make a special cake which calls "Banh Chung" . 
 To sum up, packaged foods are suitable in some case such as three meals a day but it is not suitable for the speacial day when people need to prepare carefully.
feedback:

To address this, consider using tools like Google Translate not just for word-to-word translation but to see how entire sentences or thoughts would be structured in English. The example of "Banh Chung" in Vietnam is a good start, but expanding on why traditional foods cannot be replaced by fast foods in terms of nutritional value, taste, or emotional connection might strengthen the argument. Additionally, introducing counterarguments and then refuting them can make the essay more persuasive.

To further clarify the author's stance, consider starting with a more straightforward thesis statement that outlines the main arguments that will be discussed. This guides the reader and sets clear expectations for the essay.

In conclusion, there is a solid foundation here with respect to responding to the essay prompt and maintaining a consistent point of view. To elevate the essay, focus on improving English fluency through more natural expression, correcting grammatical mistakes, and developing arguments with detailed examples and a clear structure. Practicing writing and reading in English regularly can significantly help in achieving these improvements.

prompt: Today's schools should teach their students how to survive financially in the world today.

For instance, to those students who study in technical faculty, subjects like finance are not imparted at all.

prompt: Dependance on mobile phones. Everyone is using them more or less intensively.
essay:
In recent years, the population of mobile phones has been making a great deal of public controversy due to its substantial impacts on human lifestyle. Although the idea that mobile phones do more harm than good appears reasonably, they bring more positive effects overall. 
 There are a number of reasons why the mobile phones are necessary to the individuals in daily life. First, using mobile phones is one of the most efficient and inexpensive ways to communicate with others. Before the appearance of mobile phones, delivering a message from a location to another would require the physical travels, costing unnecessary time, efforts and money. Second, people can use mobile phone as a convenient tool to caught information and news worldwide faster. For example, mobile phone users easily read news on their devices, reducing fee and time for buying a newspaper or magazines. 
 Another compelling reason for using mobile phones is that they bring a number of advantages to the society. In fact, mobile phones have functions that enable users to keep contact, thereby promoting the social behaviors and strengthening the social connections. For instance, people are more likely to lose important contacts or even forget one another if they do not use cell phones. In addition, since the industry of mobile phones has been creating more jobs and new positions, it plays a significant role in the development of society. People are treating Earth in a wrong way but it may took at least millions of years to be completely destroyed. Until that day comes, humans must concentrate on preserving the Earth. prompt: Promoting healthy lifestyle or treating diseases?
essay:

 . 
 To what extent do you agree or disagree? 
 Essay: 
 It is indisputable that health problems are one of the biggest concerns of the World Health Organization. While people argue that the local and national authorities should exceed investment in promoting a healthy lifestyle to detect diseases rather than the treatment of people who are suffering from illness. 
 On the one hand, allocating money for encouraging a healthy lifestyle is a worldwide initiative for some reasons. There is an increased propensity for people to be caught up in the pressure of work and study as a result of neglecting their health. Due to their hectic schedule, they tend to hunch over the screen, coupled with keeping the same sitting posture which is the optimal cause of many life-threatening conditions such as obesity and eye-related diseases,...Therefore, it is extremely pivotal for government to invest money in opening more affordable leisure and sports centres, encouraging people through health awareness campaigns which could raise the general level of public health.

prompt: IELTS T2: The best way for government to solve traffic congestion is provding free public transport?
essay:
Topic: The best way for government to solve the problem of traffic congestion is providing free public transport in 24 hours per day, and seven days a week. To what extent do you agree/disagree? 
 Fare-free public transport is often assumed as the best way of reducing car use and tackle congestion problems. In my view, I consider that might not be the best measure for some reasons mentioned below. 
 On the one hand, free public transport program has little impact on car drivers' behavior. The behavior of motorists and the transport mode they choose depend little on public transport fares. Researchers found that when zero-fare public transports were applied, only a small number of people who previously traveled by car made the switch. Furthermore, a vast amount of passengers attracted by it tends to be cyclists and pedestrians rather than car users. This proved the ineffectiveness of the given policy and traffic congestion would stay unsolved. 
 At the same time, the success of the free public transport movement also has a link to the quality of the service and city infrastructure. For example, in some parts of the world, commuter lines are overcrowded in rush hour. The low or adequate quality of city infrastructure could cause traffic delays and thus would makes more inconvenient to stay in public buses for a long time rather than private cars. Beside that, the quality of many public transport can not compete to the good points of cars and other vehicles. Comfort, reliability and cleanness are the motivating factors that make cars dominant over free bus service. 
 In conclusion, free public transport initiative may not be effective for mitigating congestion issues on its own and combining multipronged approaches should be implemented by government to address traffic jams. 
 293 words
feedback:
The essay is engaging and presents a stance on the issue of whether free public transport is the best way to solve traffic congestion. However, there are several areas where improvements could greatly enhance its alignment with the task requirements and its overall effectiveness.

1. **Response to the Topic**: The essay does miss a clear stance in line with the task's requirements. It's crucial to directly state to what extent you agree or disagree with the statement in the prompt. For instance, starting with "I am in total opposition to the idea that free public transport is the solution to traffic congestion" could have established a clearer viewpoint from the beginning.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, or Stylistic Issues**: There are minimal issues in these areas, but simplifying language and ensuring clarity in each sentence will make the essay more accessible. For example, instead of "fare-free public transport program has little impact," consider "free public transport does not significantly impact."

3. **Clarity of Point of View**: While you indicate disagreement with the statement, a more measured response highlighting the degree of your disagreement (e.g., "I strongly disagree") would make your viewpoint clearer. The essay tends to discuss comparative perspectives without firmly advocating for your chosen stance. 

4. **Support for Your Arguments**: The essay would benefit from following a more structured format to argue your position. Instead of referring to research or comparing different modes of transport, focus on providing one solid reason based on personal observation or experience, then expand on this with specific examples. Remember, this task seeks to evaluate your ability to express and support your personal viewpoint, not to write a comparative or research-based essay.

**Suggested Format Improvements**:
- **Paragraph 1**: Clearly paraphrase the prompt and state your precise stance. For example, address the question directly by specifying why you believe free public transport isn't the solution to traffic congestion.
- **Paragraph 2**: Introduce a single, strong reason supporting your view, rooted in personal observation or opinion.
- **Paragraph 3**: Offer a detailed example or explanation showing why your reason is valid, effectively supporting your initial argument.
- **Paragraph 4**: Summarize the discussion points: the topic, your opinion, and your supporting example, concluding with a sentence that brings the essay full circle.

Incorporating these suggestions will make your essay more in line with the task requirements and improve its coherence and persuasiveness. Follow the advised structure and focus on showcasing your personal insights and experiences related to the topic to enhance the impact of your argument.

prompt: The impact of population growth on economic development
essay:
Due to its detrimental impacts on the process of the economy's expansion, the population growth of recent decades has caused a tremendous tsunami to sweep across many countries. The excess of labor and overexploitation appear to be two ways in which the negative effects of the population growth are manifested. 
 To begin with, the abrupt increase in the country's population results in layoffs of employees. It is widely acknowledged that employee quality, not quantity, determines a company's success. As a result, each recruiting has a set restriction. Because disqualified candidates tend to turn in inadequate work with themselves, it may be challenging to achieve the highest performance and dedication, which are essential for the efficient and productive outcome. This situation becomes even further terrible when unemployment rate is going up annually in some countries. The percentage of jobless people in Britain is approximately 29,12%, substantially more than it was in the last CNN report. This troubling data is predicted to get worse over the next years. 
 In addition, the growing population forces entrepreneurs to look for ways to extract more from the environment to satisfy consumer's demand. If this process lasts long, natural resources will be used up, with an eventual economic collapse as the result. According to The New York Times, about 1,200 hectares of forests has destroyed since the beginning of 2022 for the manufacture field. It is alarming statistics that raises business's consideration about "green industry" for the long-term development. 
 In conclusion, it is clear about the bad sides that comes along with the rapid increase in population. The proper understanding about the origins and consequences of this status is needed not only for employers and economists but also governments. Timely and appropriate strategies to deal with direct results and relevant problems will be the key for a sustainable and prosperous economy.
feedback:

The use of sources such as CNN and The New York Times lends credibility to the arguments presented. However, there are areas where improvement is needed to enhance the response and fully meet the essay prompt's requirements. 

1. **Response to the Topic:** The essay primarily focuses on outlining the problems caused by population growth but fails to offer solutions. For a cause and solution essay, it is essential to propose actionable solutions to the problems discussed. Incorporating potential solutions would provide a more balanced and complete response, aligning better with the essay prompt's expectations.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues:** There are several grammatical inaccuracies and awkward phrasings throughout the essay. For instance, "the abrupt increase in the country's population results in layoffs of employees" could be clearer and more direct. Also, "29,12%" should be written as "29.12%" to adhere to standard English punctuation. Improving sentence structure and proofreading for grammatical errors will enhance the essay's clarity and readability.

3. **Point of View Clarity:** The essay clearly opposes the rapid population growth due to its economic repercussions, which is a strength. However, reinforcing this viewpoint with proposed solutions would strengthen the essay's argument and make the author's standpoint more impactful.

4. **Arguments and Support:** The essay successfully uses statistics and references to support the claim that population growth has negative effects on the economy. However, these arguments would be more persuasive if they were paired with specific, detailed solutions. Explaining how to address unemployment and the depletion of natural resources would make the arguments more robust and convincing.

In summary, while the essay effectively highlights the problems of population growth, it needs to include solutions to fully respond to the essay prompt. prompt: IELTS Writing Task 2 (drug addicts should be treated like criminals or patients)

For instance, ex-convicts with drug cases in Jakarta get his freedom after 10 years in prison. Unfortunately, he was stuck again with such a lifestyle, and could not control himself in using drugs.  On the one hand, treating drug addicts as patients who must be saved was a very noble wise decision. However, he served his sentence with a special program, it was done to eliminate his dependence on drugs. The outcome of this detention period would be very meaningful in his life, because he could be saved from the world of drug addiction, even live normally after he was released from jail.

feedback:
Your essay addresses an important debate: whether drug addicts should be imprisoned or rehabilitated. However, there are several areas where improvements can be made to strengthen your argument and make your ideas clearer.

However, the clarity of these perspectives could be enhanced. To more effectively engage with the topic, your introduction should clearly paraphrase the debate in question. 3. **Point of View**: It's crucial to distinguish between the general debate and your own viewpoint. To improve, explicitly label each viewpoint. For example, begin paragraphs with phrases like "One perspective argues..." or "On the other hand, some believe...", and for your own opinion, use "I believe..." or "In my opinion...". This clear separation will help articulate the different positions and your own stance.

4. **Arguments and Support**: You provide examples to support both imprisonment and rehabilitation but could benefit from deeper analysis and more diverse evidence. When discussing examples, explicitly state how they support the respective viewpoint. Additionally, offering statistics, studies, or broader societal impacts could strengthen your arguments.

5. **Clarity and Cohesion**: Ensure each paragraph focuses on a single main idea to keep your essay cohesive. Using clear and direct language will help your points come across more effectively. Introducing different viewpoints with clear transitions and dedicating a paragraph to each perspective can also aid in clarity.

6. **Conclusion**: While you conclude by suggesting a combination of punishment and special treatment, consider summarizing the key arguments from both sides before stating your final opinion. This not only reinforces the discussion but also presents your conclusion as a well-considered resolution to the debate.

Improving these areas will make your essay more persuasive and clearer to the reader. Remember, demonstrating a balanced understanding of both sides of a debate before concluding with your informed viewpoint is key to a strong essay.

prompt: Nowadays, a lot of offices have open-space designs instead of separate rooms
essay:
In recent years, numerous enterprises have been adopting open-space layouts in lieu of closed workplaces. In my opinion, although this propensity has proven its upsides, they are somehow eclipsed by a whole host of drawbacks. 
 It is true that the former is beneficial to the staff regarding their interaction and quality of work. First of all, this type of layout might prompt interpersonal communication among the employees, ameliorating both their mental and emotional well-being. Engaging in conversations, or exchanging ideas with others, in fact, might alleviate their working stress, and therefore improve their work productivity. Second, working in open space enables the staff to establish and maintain relationships with other co-workers. To illustrate, people in varied departments can not only share equipment and resources such as printers or stationery, but there might also be more scope for fruitful team-working projects. As a result, social bondings in the whole company would be engendered, inspiring and enhancing their working environment. 
 Nonetheless, the aforementioned merits pale in comparison with the downsides, as a shared workplace is not private enough and might be hard for the staff to focus on their work in one way or another. In terms of privacy, the higher number of people in a given space could be responsible for the feeling of unpleasantness and embarrassment. This kind of design renders employees less comfortable when working or answering confidential emails. In addition, the staff have to contend with such a high level of distractions, for example, from phone ringing or people talking. These elements might in turn interfere with their working, minimizing their focus and engagement in work. Finally, the fact that people are situated closer together might exert a threat on their health due to the increasing potential rate of infection. This may cause more absence from work, which may worsen the overall productivity. 
 In conclusion, I am firmly convinced that the upsides of the idea of open-space offices are overshadowed by its limitations.

Rather than stating them as facts, consider presenting them as observations or widely held beliefs. This approach acknowledges the complexity of the issue and avoids overly definitive statements that may not apply universally.

A conclusive paragraph that reiterates your main arguments and clearly states your position provides a strong ending to your essay. Aim for a conclusion that is more detailed, ideally encompassing at least two sentences that encapsulate the essence of your discussion.

4. Your essay's structure and content are generally clear, but consider incorporating more specific examples or data to substantiate your points. This evidence could further support your analysis and provide a more convincing argument.

By refining these aspects of your essay, you can enhance both the persuasiveness of your arguments and the overall clarity of your writing. Keep leveraging your strong vocabulary and complex sentence structure, as these are significant assets. With these adjustments, your essay will not only be more aligned with English proficiency test requirements but will also more effectively communicate your insights on the topic.

These fast-food meals that schools offer in their cafeterias destroy children's bodies and should be replaced by healthier options such as fruits and vegetables that can help the body grow. prompt: IELTS WRITNG TASK 2 - ONLINE EDUCATION PROS AND CONS
essay:

 Nowadays, especially in the current pandemic situation, technology plays an important role in education and working. Because of social distancing policies, the online meeting is the most convenient working method to keep our health leading to reducing in the number of covid cases. Another benefit of the online class is that it can save our time and cost for traveling to the study and working spaces, especially with busy people. Furthermore, with many current digital devices, online courses can be recorded meaning that we can save and rewatch them as needed, for instance, students can revise lessons to prepare for their exams or some people can playback them if they miss some parts of the video. 
 On the other hand, online education has some drawbacks relating to device connection, interaction, and teacher observation. The Online meeting can be disrupted due to many technical glitches such as internet congestion, power cut...which can influence the timeline and the content of the meeting. Moreover, when learning in conventional class, students can get a better chance to interact with their teacher and their peers, as a result, students can grasp the course more efficiently and have an ideal occasion to discuss and work in a team with each other. Also, it is hard for teachers to monitor all their student's progress to make sure they are focusing on the lesson, in fact, several students can sleep and do their own works without teacher detection during the lesson. 
 All in all, the online meeting allow students to study from anywhere and at any time, it is also cost-effective and suitable with the current pandemic situation. However, it has several disadvantages about technical connection, the lacking of interaction, and teacher's observation.

Moreover, when discussing the drawbacks such as technical issues or lack of interaction, expand your explanation by providing potential solutions or how significant these issues are in comparison to the benefits.

- Avoid redundancies to keep your writing concise and to the point.
- Detail your arguments with examples, experiences, or facts that support your perspective.
- Ensure that your advantages and disadvantages are presented in a balanced manner, which allows readers to understand the full scope of your argument.

prompt: Parents who have children in private schools should be taxed to support the state education system

 There is a plethora of compelling reasons why I still believe the existence of paying taxes, in fact, can play an integral role in the development of educational outsourcing. First, the contribution is not only used for the stated education system supportive on the contrary also for the preparatory school. Other than that, the higher academic systems are applied, the better qualifications for the students to gain the opportunity to be entitled to top-tier universities. As a result, an educated workforce with diverse socioeconomic backgrounds will be generated, and in turn a thriving economy and civilized society.

Additionally, these kinds of families will not have an abundance of money to pay for student tuition, their juveniles are forced to be dropped out of the academy. This can be led to the rise of the unemployment rate which will put a strain on the sustainable development policy of the politicians.

Your essay presents several arguments to support your viewpoint, such as the importance of taxes for educational development and the potential for increased inequalities. These are compelling points. In fact, a great deal of deposit is accounted for paying daily fees of electricity, water, paper,... in the process of operating a workplace.  In addition, working from home coincides with the fact that we are bound to accomplish a number of tasks at the same time. prompt: IELTS Writing task 2 - Curfew effects on teens
essay:
IN SOME AREAS OF THE US, A "CURFEW" IS IMPOSED, IN WHICH TEENAGERS ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE OUT OF DOORS AFTER A PARTICULAR TIME AT NIGHT UNLESS THEY ARE ACCOMPANIED BY AN ADULT. WHAT IS YOUR OPINION ABOUT THIS? 
 In the aftermath of the recent attacks on teenagers in Baltimore, the regional government has ordered to disallow teenagers from wandering outdoors alone after seven in the evening, unless accompanied by an adult. While many think that this has severely restricted the day-to-day activities of teenagers, I believe that the curfew should be imposed as a necessary step to ensure safety of the teenagers. 
 An unidentified group has been responsible for carrying out physical attacks on teenagers. According of the police reports, all the attacks on teenagers have taken place after eight in the evening. A teenager wandering alone at night is vulnerable to such attacks. The present curfew will help to avoid any further attacks on teenagers, particularly in the evening. 
 Moreover, the government allows the teenagers to be out of doors after seven if they are accompanied by an adult. The police report also mentions that all the teenagers attacked were alone at that time of the crime. Teenagers usually panic in such dire situations and are not able to defend themselves. There is little chance that the group will attack teenagers accompanied by adults since adults will be able to handle the situation more effectively. 
 Thus, the curfew does not completely restrict the movements of teenagers at night as an adult can accompany them in case of urgencies, while at the same time, the safety of the teenagers is ensured. This curfew will prevent additional attacks on the teenagers and should be imposed at least till the criminals are caught by the authorities.
feedback:
Your essay addresses the topic of imposing a curfew on teenagers to ensure their safety. However, there are several areas for improvement to make your essay more effective and aligned with the requirements of English proficiency tests. Below are some detailed points to consider in revising your essay:

1. **Response to Topic:** It's essential to directly address the given topic. Your essay should not rely on researched information, as you won't have access to the internet during the actual test. Instead, focus on demonstrating your understanding of current events through general knowledge. Try rephrasing the prompt in your own words without introducing specific incidents that are not mentioned in the essay question.

2. **Essay Structure:** Consider organizing your essay into a five-paragraph format for clarity and coherence. The structure should include:
   - A paragraph paraphrasing the prompt,
   - A paragraph discussing the advantages (pro opinion) of the topic,
   - A paragraph highlighting the disadvantages (con opinion),
   - A paragraph stating your personal opinion,
   - A concluding paragraph summarizing the discussion.
   
   This format will help you present a balanced view and adequately discuss your personal stance on the matter, which is crucial for meeting the essay requirements.

3. **Content and Arguments:** Your essay tends to focus more on presenting a case based on specific incidents rather than discussing your personal opinion on the curfew for teenagers. It reads more like a report than an opinion essay. Future essays should include clear arguments for and against the issue before stating your own position. This approach demonstrates your ability to analyze different viewpoints and articulate your thoughts clearly.

4. **Language and Style Issues:**
   - **Spelling and Grammar:** There are no significant spelling errors, but be mindful of grammar and the use of articles ("an unidentified group").
   - **Stylistic Issues:** Aim for a more formal tone by avoiding phrases that may appear too informal or conversational for an academic essay.

5. **Clarity of Your Point of View:** Make sure your personal opinion is clearly stated and distinguished from the general discussion. It should be evident which statements are your beliefs versus general commentary on the situation.

6. **Descriptive Arguments:** Expand on your reasons for supporting or opposing the curfew by including both the positive and negative aspects. This depth will ensure that your essay thoroughly explores the topic and provides a well-rounded view.

In summary, while your essay introduces a relevant discussion on the safety of teenagers, refining its structure, directly addressing the essay prompt without relying on specific research, and clearly articulating your own opinion will significantly improve its effectiveness. Remember to use the five-paragraph format to organize your thoughts and to balance your discussion by considering multiple viewpoints. This approach will not only enhance the clarity and coherence of your essay but also demonstrate your English proficiency more convincingly.

prompt: Report: English-language TV programmes in my country
essay:
In your report you should deal with: 
 - the languages poeple learn,who learns them and where they learn them 
 - recommendations for improving language-learning in your country 
 __________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ 
 Introduction 
 The objective of my report is to analyze the importance and the influence English-language TV programmes have in Czechia, to explain the effect these programmes produce and to make recommendations of how the situation could be improved. 
 Popularity of imported programmes 
 The amount of programmes watched in Czechia, coming mainly from the USA, have increased significantly during the last years, and that could be explained by different causes. 
 Firstly, it's caused by fascination and apparent consumption edeavours of Western culture since the times of communism when this was the forbidden fruit. 
 Secondly, the new phenomenon of TV platforms like Netflix, HBO and others becomes more and more common in average Czech households. The stories are narative, well-written and extremely catchy. Moreover these platforms provides no adds which caused that Czech TV programmes became intolerable. 
 Effects on local culture 
 The percentage of English-language TV programmes is easily recognizable within Czech society and the local culture is heavily influenced by them. If you walk throughout any street in Czechia, you will hear someone talking about the last TV shows like Game of Thrones, Lucifer or Rick and Morty. The people have quickly accepted that this TV shows are much more important and so much better than the local ones. 
 Due to the lack of Czech dabbing in most of this new series, people are forced to listen the original voices of the actors and passively learn English, which, in my opinion, is the best by-product of this international platforms. 
 Recommendations 
 I think the government should have cancelled all the TV programmes like ČT1, ČT2, Nova, Prima, etc. and sell the old and new Czech films and series containing english subtitles to the international platforms (again I have to highlight Netflix as the hot candidate due to its' inevitable popularity in this land). 
 As I mentioned before, due to the enormous amount of adds, likeability of Czech programmes is rapidly decreasing and instead of to continue this decay, let's do a step forward, embrace internationality and show our culture to the world.
feedback:
The essay aimed to address the influence of English-language TV programs in Czechia and suggest improvements for language learning in the country. However, several aspects need attention and improvement.

Firstly, it's essential to understand and respond directly to the given topic. The original task was to discuss the languages people learn, who learns them, where they learn them, and provide recommendations for improving language-learning in your country. The focus on English-language TV programs does not fully align with these requirements. Directly addressing the original instructions could significantly enhance the relevance of your essay.

Regarding the structure and format, the essay reads more like a brainstorm or outline rather than a complete essay. A well-structured essay typically includes a clear introduction, developed body paragraphs, and a conclusive summary or recommendation. Each section should directly support or address the essay's main topic, offering clear arguments and evidence. Strive for a balance between discussing the current situation and offering specific, actionable recommendations for improvement.

Several spelling, grammar, and stylistic issues also detract from the essay's overall clarity and professionalism. For instance, "poeple" should be corrected to "people," and "edeavours" to "endeavors." Additionally, the essay occasionally uses informal language ("TV shows are much more important and so much better") or makes broad, unsupported statements. Working on sentence structure and ensuring that each statement is directly supported by evidence or clear logical reasoning will strengthen your arguments.

The point of view is understandable but could be made clearer with more precise language and structure. Rather than suggesting the cancellation of all Czech TV programs, consider proposing how these could be adapted or improved to enhance language learning. Recommendations should be feasible and directly linked to the essay's earlier analysis.

Lastly, it's beneficial to gradually build your English skills through consistent practice and study. Starting with simpler assignments and progressively tackling more complex topics can help improve both your comprehension and writing abilities.

In summary, focusing on directly answering the essay prompt, refining the structure and clarity of your writing, addressing grammatical and spelling errors, and providing well-supported arguments will greatly improve your essays.

prompt: IELTS Task2. Is 24-hour television a good thing? Or it may bring some harm.

Overall, focusing on the prompt's specific requirements, refining grammar and style, clearly stating a point of view, and offering well-supported arguments will significantly improve the essay's effectiveness. prompt: IELTS: Formal Letter: School renovation and volunteering
essay:
Write a letter to the principal of the school and say: 
 - how would you be able to help 
 - when and why would you do it 
 - who will help you to do it 
 Dear Sir or Madam,

 It is believed that the idea of using animals for medical experiments is morally wrong. They argue that animals have the right to live free from unnecessary harm and exploitation. Animals have intrinsic worth and deserve to be treated with respect and compassion. Using animals for experiments, especially when alternative methods are available, is seen as a violation of their rights and dignity. In comparison to animal research, 3D cell cultures, for example, give a more human-relevant model. ( 8) Researchers may examine human-specific reactions and gain a better understanding of human physiology by employing human cells. 
 Despite the above-mentioned ideas, I am a proponent of the use of animals in medical trials due to the safety testing proposed. Animals, especially mammals, share physiological and genetic similarities with humans. This biological overlap allows researchers to study the effects of substances on animals to gain insights into their potential effects on human beings. Furthermore, if animal testing is conducted, it can reveal unforeseen reactions or side effects that were not predicted from preclinical studies or in vitro experiments. These unexpected responses may arise due to complex interactions within living organisms that are difficult to replicate in alternative models. 
 In conclusion, although animal testing may be harsh and inhumane, it still needs to be conducted for safety reasons.

essay:

 In recent years, a volunteering activity is considered as a mandatory programme which presents a major merit for pupils. Such mishap is quite prevalent as for fresh graduates because they ordinarily receive minimum wages for their lack of experience but their supervisors tend to allot many repetitive or arduous tasks to them. 
 In addition, in cases of professionals in academic or researching fields such as physicists or astronomers, it's satisfaction and contentment in the jobs that sustain their commitment and dedication to their companies. This is because those specialists usually find the freedom to pursue their passion the most crucial perk in workplace; in other words, they are not tightly bound by money incentives. 
 To conclude, although it is undeniable that every individual has to make ends meet no matter what their livelihoods are, money should rarely stand out as the vital element that keeps people happy in their jobs when other essential factors like liberty, work comfort or promotion are increasingly of great importance to employees these days.

prompt: My IELTS essay on Environment & Animals in the verge of extinction
essay:
Many animals both on land and in the sea are being brought to the verge of extinction due to human activities. In this essay, I will discuss various reasons behind this trend, and present some solutions. 
 There are human factors instigating the increasing extinction of animals on land and in the sea. On the one hand, the natural habitat of many terrestrial animals has been lost due to deforestation, a trend that leaves these species with no place to live, feed, or reproduce, indirectly resulting in their death. Moreover, land animals are vulnerable to rampant hunting, which is to blame for the deaths of many species. On the other hand, fish exploitation is threatening marine life. Humans are overfishing to an extent that gives fish inadequate time to reproduce, thus significantly reducing the population in an area. Furthermore, human-induced disasters, particularly oil spills, have polluted huge areas in the ocean, causing the deaths of thousands of species. 
 In order to tackle this problem, the responsibilities lay on the government. For terrestrial animals, measures that focus on high-rise buildings in urban planning can accommodate a large number of people, removing the need for deforestation to build residential areas. Besides, when a life sentence for poaching comes into practice, it can act as a strong deterrent to poachers, preventing their mass killing of animals. For marine lives, the government can fund fishers to help them integrate aquaculture into their work so as to reduce exploiting ocean fish. In addition, to address human-induced catastrophes, the government should implement more regulations on operation to lower the risks of human-caused errors. 
 In conclusion, the increasing extinction of many animals on land and in the sea is due to numerous human activities. To halt this trend, the government must take action.

prompt: There are more challenges and risks than benefits to new technology.

While many people are of the opinion that the advent of state-of-the-art technology would do more harm than good, I would argue that these scientific breakthroughs would benefit humans in every aspect. 
 It is undeniable that the introduction of new technology is associated with many risks. One of the most concerning issues related to technological development is the threat it poses to the environment. It has been a perennial problem to solve the issue of resource scarcity, as the amount of resources used for producing a high-tech machine is enormous, let alone for inventing new ones through errors and trials. More severely, the process of creating a machine requires the burning of many fossil fuels, which, needless to say, either deteriorates the air quality or makes the bad condition of the environment irreversible. A conspicuous case in point is that it is not uncommon to witness many factories, though promise appropriate processes of waste and water disposal, fail to fulfill their compromise, which is evident by the fact that there is still heavy dark smog emitted through the chimneys of these factories. 
 That said, let us not forget that the optimal purpose of these high-tech inventions is to serve humans. The advent of autonomation and robotics have helped carry all the heavy lifting for humans, reducing the heavy burden for a large and highly skilled workforce. Mass-produced products are believed to have a higher level of efficiency and uniformity compared to man-made, and it is not to mention the fact that machine-made products are more sophisticated as machines can pay attention to the most trivial details that cannot be seen by humans' eyes. For this reason, many companies favor machine-made products over their human-made counterparts as this helps to reduce the cost of products, which benefits both the business and the consumers. Many novel inventions in household appliances are also one of the perks of technological advances. In the past, it would take hours to finish all the household chores. In this contemporary era, however, with the help of modern technology, machines can do all the work for humans. The time spent on doing domestic chores could be more well-spent on other work, both working and entertaining. 
 In conclusion, although it cannot be denied that there are many hazards in the enhancement of technology, I strongly believe that if used properly, these inventions would benefit us in one way or another.

prompt: Essay about changing jobs or not
essay:
People have different views about whether individuals should continue their line of work or not. This essay will articulate both views along with my perception. 
 On the one hand, there are several reasons why a person should stay in the same job for life. Firstly, commiting to one work ensures stable income and life-insurance. To be clearer, every company must legally pay not only health insurances but also proper salaries for their employees as long as those workers have commitment to work for the company over a year. Therefore, those employees who have decent job with stable income are more likely to have no insecurities about finacial problems or life securities thanks to the company's ensurance in the long term. Secondly, employees who consistently pursue one certain occupation are more likely to get promotion opportunities after years experiencing various tasks, which not only benefits themselves in terms of working experience but also brings valuable contribution to company, enterprise and society as a whole. 
 However, some might argue that switching jobs could bring more advantages for a myriad of reasons. Firstly, workers changing their jobs regularly could be equipped with a wide-ranging variety of professional skills. Therefore, they will be better prepared for the new worl entailed at any position, which means that companies can save their time and money on training new employees. Secondly, moving to a new job allows people to broaden their horizons in numerous fields. For instance, people who do various jobs whereby they can enlarge their social circles by striking up new relationship with new colleagues, which offers multipiled advantages to bussiness and life. 
 In conclusion, although both views have its own pros, I believe that staying for one certain profession is more beneficial for worker, company and society in the long run.

prompt: IELTS Writing Task 2: should information be freely accessible?
essay:
About half a century ago, the classified Pentagon's military documents were leaked by a New York Times investigative journalist. These papers exposed an unprecedented level of dishonesty and governmental corruption in withholding information about the ongoing Vietnam War to the public. Their release naturally became a celebrated event among those who advocate for the "people's power". In recent years, a similar trend emerges, manifested in the appearance of Wikileak - a page that has leaked several top-secret U.S. diplomatic cables. Now, the self-proclaimed "people's advocates" are taking a step further and demanding free access to not only political documents but all kind of information, ranging from scientific to business. Others yet disagree, as they believe that certain information is too sensitive to be left in the light. While the former stance has its own merits, I personally tend to the latter. 
 The "people's advocates" can draw examples from history to support their cause. Historically, the obstruction of free information has in turn impeded scientific progress. Take England for example, in the late 18th century, tension with other European countries had led the Kingdom to shut down its door on the Continent. Nationalism prevented important scientific breakthroughs from both sides of the Chanel to travel. This had cost England years of progress, as the country lost its prominence as a center for academic research to Paris and Berlin. This example serves to show the detrimental effects of withholding information in research. Similarly, a lack of transparency in business can lead to negative ramification sand even corruption. In fact, a type of containing information in the stock market known as insider trading is criminal.  On the other hand, some scientific research can give rise to technical breakthroughs that are too valuable to be made public. This type of technical information is closely connected to corporate information. In a market economy, corporates thrive on their technical advantages and superior strategies. If such technology and strategies are made public, the market loses its competition and diversity which benefits consumers. In fact, governments like the U.S., Russia, and China have been known to raise an army of hackers whose sole job is to gain access to critical information internal to foreign big companies. prompt: [IELTS Writing Task 2] Physical or mental strength is important for success in sport?
essay:
It is controversial that whether physical power or mental effort has more importance in sport victory. While I believe that spiritual strength well contributes to an athlete's proficiency, I would also argue that physical fitness plays a pivotal role in sport. 
 On the one hand, it is no doubt that emotions have certain impact on the performance of one player. Before the game, if he is encouraged by his surroundings, the athlete does obviously enhance his self-esteem as well as self-confidence and is likely to make greater efforts to deserve his love he has received. In contrast, witnessing bad events right before the sport contest, individuals seem to be over-concerned and disappointed. As a result, they cannot keep a calm feeling and be distracted from the match. The situation even gets worse when considering team sport as the lac of productivity of one member becomes a black hole at his role play and may also make others frustrated and easy to lose temper. 
 On the other hand, there are a host of reasons why success in sport requires physical well-being. Firstly, when participating in any training program or sport game, health check is a must. People are only accepted to take part in sport games if they satisfy all the necessary requirements. Even if one who has mental strength but cannot meet the physical standards such as weight or endurance is eliminated. For example, a basketball player is demanded to be at least 1,65 meters in height in Vietnam. Secondly, sport training is a tough process lasting for a period of time before getting ready for official matches. Without persistence and stable body-building, no one can follow sport career in a long term. 
 In conclusion, despite the fact that athletes' feelings influence their result, I am of the opinion that success in sport mostly rely on physical fitness. Coaches should allocate more money on physical training in order to guarantee the health of sport players.
feedback:
The essay effectively addresses the topic, debating the relative importance of mental versus physical strength in sports. The viewpoint is clear and maintains a balanced discussion of both aspects before revealing a preference for physical fitness as the key to sporting success. However, there are several areas where the essay could be significantly improved for clarity, adherence to the task's requirements, and overall impact.

1. **Response to the Prompt**: The essay starts by labeling the topic as controversial, which might seem unnecessary or exaggerated since the prompt simply asks for a discussion of two views and your opinion. A better approach would be to straightforwardly introduce the two perspectives on athlete success—physical and mental strength—and then mention your intention to explore both before stating your view. Try to directly engage with what the question asks without adding extra weight to the topic.

2. **Essay Structure**: The current essay comprises four paragraphs, but it would benefit from expanding into the five-paragraph format typically expected in such tasks. This includes an introduction, three body paragraphs (one for discussing physical strength, one for discussing mental effort, and one to elaborate on your stance or compare the two), followed by a conclusion. This structure not only makes your essay more organized but also ensures that you have enough space to fully develop your ideas.

3. **Clarity and Coherence**: While the arguments are generally clear, they could be made more compelling and easier to follow with some improvements:
   - Avoid generalizations and exaggeration, and stick to clear, straightforward arguments.
   - Ensure each paragraph focuses on a single main idea, supported by specific examples or explanations. 
   - Transitions between sentences and paragraphs could be smoother to help the reader follow the progression of your arguments more easily.

4. **Stylistic Issues**: Pay attention to sentence structure to avoid awkward phrasing. For example, "emotions have certain impact on the performance of one player" could be clearer as "emotions significantly impact a player's performance." Avoid repetition of phrases and aim for conciseness to make your argument more powerful.

5. **Spelling and Grammar**: There are minor spelling and grammar issues throughout the essay. For instance, "sport victory" could be changed to "sports victories" or "success in sports" for correctness and clarity. Proofreading more carefully or using spellcheck tools can help eliminate these errors.

6. **Supporting Arguments**: While you do provide examples and reasons to back up your viewpoints, they could be more detailed and descriptive. Instead of stating general claims, delve deeper into how and why mental or physical attributes affect an athlete’s performance. Use more real-life examples or hypothetical situations to illustrate your points vividly.

7. **Conclusion**: Your conclusion succinctly underscores the preference for physical fitness but consider reinforcing it by briefly summarizing how it compares or interacts with mental effort based on the arguments made in the essay. This could offer a more comprehensive wrap-up of your discussion.

By revising the essay with these points in mind, focusing on structured development of arguments, clearer expression of ideas, and adherence to the essay format, the overall coherence, and persuasiveness of the writing will significantly improve.

prompt: [ Writting Task 2 ] Rent vs Own: Pros and Cons

prompt: Scientists predict in the near future, cars will be driven by computers, not people. Why? Effects?
essay:

 To begin with, there are two primary justifications for this trend. The first one lies in the fact that human beings tend to pursue convenience. With the emergence of driverless automobiles, there is no need for people to drive the vehicle themselves. Therefore, the proliferation of autonomous cars is a natural progression. Another justification is the fast-paced technological innovations. This century has witnessed the significant development of technology and science in all walks of life. In transportation, some big corporations and companies have gained successful achievements in testing self-driving vehicles namely Tesla, BWW; as a result, driverless vehicles will soon be ubiquitous in the world. 
 However, this trend can exert obviously positive influence on human lives. Most accidents are indeed due to reckless behaviours of human beings; hence, cars with the autopilot feature will assist in lowering or removing the risks in driving, which enhances road safety. Safety aside, the development of self-driving car industry is likely to boost the economic prospect since many expenses in human-driving transportation, such as drivers' salary, can be cut down on, leading to the saving of budget on commuting and transportation which can be allocated to other important fields. 
 In conclusion, the popularity of autonomous cars inevitably occurs soon due to human's preference for convenience and technological breakthroughs. However, safety in transportation and economic prosperity are the advantages this trend brings to.
feedback:
Your essay provides an interesting perspective on the future of autonomous vehicles and their impact on society. However, there are several areas where improvements could significantly enhance clarity, coherence, and the overall argument you present.

Firstly, the introduction of your essay hints at a negative view of driverless cars with the phrase "detrimental benefits," yet this phrase is contradictory as "detrimental" means harmful, and "benefits" means positive outcomes. This makes your stance unclear. Be specific about the reasons you believe autonomous cars will have a negative or positive impact. Clearly stating these reasons will strengthen your thesis and provide a focused direction for your essay.

The use of "however" suggests a contrast or opposing view is next, but the essay hasn't yet presented a clear initial argument or topic sentence for the paragraph. Using "however" more effectively after establishing a clear point will improve the logical flow of your argument.

The essay does well to identify potential positives of driverless cars, such as increased safety and economic benefits. However, it doesn't fully explore the reasons for opposing viewpoints or the negative consequences, which would be expected given the introduction's suggestion of detriment. Present both sides more equitably or clarify your viewpoint as primarily positive or negative to provide a more rounded discussion.

Regarding language and structure, there are minor spelling and grammatical errors ("BWW" likely meant to be "BMW") and places where simpler language could convey your points more clearly to the reader. Additionally, breaking down complex ideas into shorter sentences can aid in making your argument more digestible.

To improve, consider the following:
- Clarify your position on autonomous cars at the beginning. Are they beneficial or harmful, or both? Be explicit and use this stance to guide your essay.
- Avoid contradictory terms like "detrimental benefits."
- Use transitional words like "however" only when presenting an opposing viewpoint or contrasting idea.
- Address both the advantages and disadvantages more clearly if your aim is to present a balanced view.
- Pay attention to spelling and grammar to enhance readability.
- Simplify your language to ensure your argument is accessible to all readers.

Your essay tackles an important and timely topic. With these adjustments for clarity, coherence, and argument structure, your essay will be more compelling and effective in presenting a clear, well-supported viewpoint on autonomous vehicles.

prompt: More and more people prefer choosing online courses to learn, than attending regular classes

Another positive effect of virtual classes is students can finalize their course from other comfort spaces instead of having to go to school or extra classes.  On the other hand, online classes certainly have numerous disadvantages associated with them. To start with, one of the most indispensable things about traditional classes is the better interaction between teacher and student. Online schooling will lead to limit the social interaction between fellows and teachers. As a result, lack of interaction and competition will lead to the situation that to loss of motivation, easy boredom. In addition, if students spend too much time sticking their eyes on a screen, they will get some diseases like obesity, headache, or backache... Another consequence of studying online is students easily lose contraction because there are several attractive things such as phones or computer games. At the same time, teachers cannot control what they are doing during the lesson, which causes ineffective lessons. 
 In conclusion, after analyzing both sides of the argument it is not hard to see that traditional learning and online learning have their merits and demerits. However, studying online can bring about some drawbacks, I firmly believe that regular classes can bring more benefits.
feedback:

This is crucial for setting the context and engaging the reader. prompt: Discuss wealthy or developing nations should provide financial support to poorer countries
essay:
These days, owing to the evolution of the world, it is frequently contended that developed countries ought to sponsor underdeveloped nations for better healthcare, academic quality and welfare. Conversely, opponents deem that developing countries should be responsible for these benefits. This essay will address both viewpoints and express my personal opinion. 
 On the one hand, developing nations have the responsibility of sharing specific support with poorer aspects of the world. To begin with, emerging nations tend to possess abundant workers and volunteers due to the expeditious growth of population. Thus, impoverished countries with high rates of illiteracy can be assisted by knowledgeable educators, instructors, farmers from developing nations as these volunteers have the ability to teach unwise people to harvest crops, erect houses and numerous practical skills. This method can possibly help underdeveloped nations to suffer from hunger, poverty and diseases. Furthermore, middle-income countries also have other viable solutions to aid the poorer ones. To be specific, developing sides of the world can offer guidance on how to get over difficulties of an unhealthy economy and curb social ills to low-income nations instead of lavish spending in unnecessary fields. Hence, they can not only maintain developing countries' systems but also can fulfill the requirements of poor ones. 
 On the other hand, there are several reasons why wealthy nations should aid poorer countries in some aspects of their economic and society. In the first place, what makes developed nations important is ample and high-quality facilities, which can make significant contributions to non-wealthy countries' systems. It is generally believed that economic powerhouses can effortlessly utilize their sufficiency of modern technology and education quality in the process of establishing superior profit organizations and manufacturing plants in destitute nations. Hence, poor countries' people will improve their job opportunities and obtain self-sufficient lives, gaining economic benefits for both countries. Moreover, industrialized nations are predisposed to have worldwide attention which are fundamental to raising funds for the underdeveloped sides of the world. To justify, the establishment of the Covax Facility ensuring the global equitable access to Covid-19 vaccines is mostly contributed by wealthy countries. By this way, two different sides of the world are acknowledged to be connected gradually. 
 In conclusion, even though both viewpoints have their own merits, I side with the notion that industrialized nations should make the most significant contribution to underdeveloped countries. Nevertheless, it is highly recommended that every country should play a considerable part in creating a civilized society.
feedback:
The essay effectively addresses the prompt by discussing the reasons why developed countries should help underdeveloped ones, alongside the counter-argument that developing countries should take responsibility for their own advancement. However, there are areas where significant improvement is required to enhance clarity, coherence, and the overall structure of the essay. 

Firstly, the introduction part of the essay indicates a plan to discuss various viewpoints and express a personal opinion. However, it would be more effective to directly state the main argument in the introduction, rather than explaining how the essay will proceed. This approach would create a stronger thesis and make the essay more compelling from the beginning.

Regarding the structure, it's crucial to properly allocate your personal opinion within the body of the essay, not just in the conclusion. By integrating your viewpoint as a distinct section within the main body, it allows for deeper exploration and justification of your stance. In this essay, the personal opinion is mentioned only towards the end, which limits the opportunity to fully develop and support this perspective. Additionally, the conclusion should summarize the key points made throughout the essay, rather than introducing new information or only restating one side of the argument. A more balanced summary of the discussion would strengthen the conclusion.

On the aspect of language and style, there are a few grammatical and stylistic issues that need attention. For instance, the phrase "unwise people" could be seen as judgmental; consider using a more neutral term like "individuals with limited education" instead. Also, be mindful of phrases that could be simplified for clarity and ease of understanding, such as replacing "possess abundant workers and volunteers" with "have many workers and volunteers."

Moreover, while addressing the opposing views, it’s essential to present clear and descriptive arguments. The essay does quite well in explaining how both developing and developed countries can contribute to global welfare, yet it could benefit from more specific examples and clearer explanations in certain sections. For example, the assertion that developing countries can teach practical skills to improve conditions in underdeveloped nations is compelling but would be more convincing with detailed examples of such initiatives.

In conclusion, focusing on refining the thesis statement, reorganizing the structure to include a clear section for personal opinion, enhancing the conclusion, and polishing grammar and style will significantly improve the essay's effectiveness. By addressing these points, the essay will not only better adhere to academic standards but also provide a more persuasive and coherent argument on the topic.

prompt: Studying at university or get a job straight after school? Discuss both views

The labour market is becoming more and more competitive than ever before, as hundreds of applicants often chase well remunerated works, and university gradutes usually get a much higher salary than those without a degree. Furthermore, most jobs require specific knowledge and skills. For instance, skilled workers are needed for sectors such as information technology and engineering.

Secondly, a person who chooses to get a job instead of pursuing higher education is likely to make a rapid progress in their career. This may help them to obtain a lot of real experience and skills in their chosen profession.

To improve clarity and readability, try to make your sentences simpler and more direct. This not only aids in understanding but also ensures that the essay is approachable for readers of varying English proficiency levels.

In conclusion, the essay is on the right track with its balanced discussion of an important decision facing young people today. By refining the structure, clarity, and argumentation, as well as correcting grammatical issues, the essay will significantly improve and effectively communicate the complexities of choosing between further education and entering the workforce.

 Lawbreakers commit crime again for a number of reasons. From the objective perspective, it is indisputable that people with criminal record often have difficulties in adapting to the life outside prison. This is partly because after being imprisoned for such a long time, they become conditioned to the life behind the bars. Furthermore, it is the prejudice and the concern of the society that cannot easily accept these offenders. Some people will look down on these prisoners or others may have a fear that those having criminal record can re-offend anytime. As a result, many people have to struggle to find paid-jobs after gaining freedom outside the jail. They may resort to crime such as bootlegging or robbery as a way of making a living. From the subjective perspective, in some cases, criminal behavior is a mindset. Regardless of being influenced by witnessing violence from a young age or being born naturally, it is challenging to change these immoral behaviors. For that reason, the likelihood of re-offending in the criminals who have aggressive mindset is ominous. 
 Many measures have been given to resolve this problem. First of all, it is the responsibility of the government to launch training programs in prison to help lawbreaker distinguish between right and wrong and develop new skills. Additionally, ex-convicts should receive counseling before re-entering society. This will aid them to get an overview of the life outside the world. Secondly, with the assistance of rehabititaion, prisoners can avoid anti-social behaviors and make right choices to their lives. 
 In conclusion, there have been two main factors that lead to the re-offence of some criminal. Both authorities and offenders themselves have to take concerted effort in addressing this problem for the sake of their society.
