While it is believed that working for only an organization is the fundamental choice, some people suppose that doing for varying ones is much better than the former. From my perspective, I would argue that it is better to work for different corporations beyond similar ones. 
 On the one hand, there is clear evidence for people to support the view that working with the same organization in one's whole working life is justifiable. First and foremost, it is a well-known fact that long-term employees are accustomed to their enterprises for an extended period of time. Accordingly, they will have a profound understanding of how it operates. If staff do their job for a long time, they will become more proficient at work as well as enjoy a wide range of perks such as better promotion and incentives. Secondly, there is no disputing that there would be many chances for employees' recognition and greater job security. Employers, for instance, who always dismiss short-term staff, value royalty and ensure positions of long-term ones. 
 On the other hand, there are obvious perks that could be witnessed from the fact that proponents of job-hopping can point out some potential merits of individuals' independence and varying skills. To start with, it is commonly believed that job hoppers will become more independent as they also try their hand at different jobs. In other words, they not only collaborate effectively with more colleagues but also adapt to various work environments. This is one of the fundamental foundations to help employees become more flexible and stand by themselves as well. Last but not least, another point that should be taken into consideration is that employees can acquire a variety of skills to become more versatile. Executives, who work in different fields, also have job opportunities with a lucrative income, as a typical example. 
 In conclusion, for the reasons mentioned above, it seems to me that working for different organizations is more likely to be successful than working for the same ones.

The expression of personal opinion could also benefit from grammatical adjustments to convey the message more accurately.

While it's mentioned, expanding on this with a dedicated paragraph could significantly enhance the essay by offering deeper insight into the writer’s perspective. This addition would not only meet the essay prompt’s requirements more thoroughly but also enrich the narrative with personal reasoning behind the preference for working in different organizations.

The conclusion reiterates the writer's viewpoint, which is good practice. However, to elevate the essay's effectiveness further, including a dedicated paragraph before the conclusion to discuss personal reasons and opinions in detail would provide a stronger, more persuasive argument. The conclusion would then serve as a more powerful closing statement, summarizing the expanded discussion and reinforcing the writer’s stance.

Spelling and grammar are mostly accurate, but attention to these aspects in certain sentences would polish the essay further. Also, focusing on a clearer and more direct style can improve the overall readability and impact of the essay. Simplifying complex sentences and ensuring grammatical correctness will make the arguments more compelling and easier for all readers to understand.

prompt: Many countries spend a lot of money in the arts. Some people think investment in ....IELTS writing

Some arts works, like sculptures and paintings can beautify our public area,such as library,subway station,even the sanitary. If the arts prospers ,we will have more enjoyable lives with the buildings in variety of styles. Besides,arts enables us to release some pressure, keeping us in a better mood in daily life. 
 Although the arts is considered essential by some people,someone else think that the public facilities far more deserve to be focus on .The ordinary citizens are more interested in infrastructure(school,transport,power and water supply) which have direct impact on their life quality. Comparably,sculptures,paintings and dramas are luxuries to most people ,failing to bring actual advantages to them. In summary, focusing on a clear structure that includes all required elements of the essay prompt, revising for spelling and grammatical accuracy, and elaborating on examples for clarity will significantly strengthen the essay. prompt: IELTS Writing task 2: Strict punishments for driving offences or other measures would be effective
essay:
People have different views when they are looking for a method to ensure the safety of vehicles and pedestrians. I believe that the answer for this question should be the combination of punishments and range of measures. 
 On the one hand, strict punishments can certainly help to ensure to drive more safely. Harsh penalties for careless driver prevent them from repeating their offences again. The most serious penalty could be prison sentence of up to 5 years. The aims of these punishment is to warn dangerous drivers against breaking the rule, furthermore, raise their driving habits. As a result drivers would be more careful behind the wheel and more disciplined. 
 On the other hand, safe driving can be better in different ways without the need of punishing drivers. I believe that government should spend more money on upgrading public transportation which might lead to fewer people travel by cars. One thing that is noticeable about children is that they can be easily educated than adults, traffic law should be added as a part of education sectors in primary school to raise the road safety awareness. This is significant that traffic signs should be placed along the road in order to give drivers adequate time to respond to the command. 
 In conclusion, while punishments can prevent bad driving and make drivers worry about payment. other road safety measures should be conducted into reality. It would be more effectively if we put them together to make a huge effect on road safety.
feedback:
The essay presents thoughts on how to enhance the safety of vehicles and pedestrians, focusing on a mix of punishments and measures. Here are some focused suggestions for improvement based on the provided guidelines and identified areas of concern:

1. **Response to Topic**: The essay attempts to address the topic by presenting two perspectives on improving road safety. However, it's crucial to structure the essay to discuss both public viewpoints and your personal opinion separately. Each viewpoint should have its paragraph to clarify the distinction between public opinions and your stance. The recommended structure includes an introduction, one paragraph for each of the two public viewpoints, one for your personal opinion, and a conclusion—summing up to five paragraphs.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues**:
    - There are some grammar mistakes that need correction. For instance, use "The aims of these punishments are" instead of "The aims of these punishment is" since "aims" is plural.
    - After introductory phrases like "As a result," a comma is needed, so it should be "As a result, drivers...". 
    - It's important to avoid run-on sentences, especially in the conclusion. Try breaking down complex thoughts into simpler, clearer sentences to make your point more effectively.

3. **Clarity of Point of View**:
    - Your essay would benefit from clearer distinction between general viewpoints and your personal opinion. Use phrases like "Some people believe..." or "On the other hand, others argue..." for public viewpoints. When expressing your opinion, phrases like "I believe that..." or "In my view..." can help clarify it's your personal stance.

4. **Arguments and Support**:
    - While your essay mentions valid points supporting both the usage of punishments and other measures for road safety, make sure each argument is developed thoroughly in its paragraph. This provides a more robust and detailed exploration of each viewpoint.
    - Incorporate specific examples or data where possible to strengthen your arguments. For example, when suggesting harsh penalties, including statistics or studies that show their effectiveness can make your argument more compelling.

Lastly, ensure each paragraph flows logically to the next, maintaining a coherent structure throughout your essay. Connecting phrases can help transition between paragraphs smoothly, guiding the reader through your argumentation process.

Remember, practice and careful attention to feedback are key to improving your writing skills. Keep working on these aspects, and your essays will become more structured, clear, and persuasive.

prompt: IELTS 1 - The expenditure on consumed goods. The data was collected in France and the UK in 2010
essay:
The expenditure on consumed goods is demonstrated in the chart. The data was collected in France and the UK in 2010. 
 Overall, the spending on cars was in the UK was of greatest value among all statistics while the opposite was true for the expense in perfume in the UK. 
 The number of France in cars was 400 thousand pounds while that of the UK was 50 thousand higher. As a computer, the quantities of Franch and the UK stood at about 370 thousand and 350 thousand pounds respectively. 
 Meanwhile, the volume of cameras in France reached 150 thousand pounds, which was significantly lower than in the UK at 350 thousand pounds. In terms of books, the figure for the UK added up to dramatically over 400 million pounds in comparison with 300 million pounds for that France. As for perfume, the figure for France and UK were calculated at respectively 200 million and 140 million.
feedback:

There are a few instances where the use of definite articles and verbs is incorrect, affecting the clarity and accuracy of your sentences. Paying attention to these details will improve the readability of your essay.

3. **Point of View Clarity:**
Your point of view regarding the data comparison between France and the UK is somewhat clear, but it can be made more distinct with smoother transitions and clearer comparisons. Try to directly state your observations or conclusions about the data to make your point of view unmistakable to the reader.

4. **Arguments and Descriptions:**
While you provide numerical data to support your comparisons, your arguments would benefit from more detailed descriptions and analysis. For instance, discussing why there might be such differences in spending between the two countries or what these figures might indicate about consumer behavior in France and the UK would make your essay more insightful. Also, ensure your numbers are correctly attributed (e.g., millions instead of thousands) to prevent confusion.

Remember, practice in sentence construction and revisiting grammar rules, especially around article and verb usage, will greatly benefit your writing. Try to be precise in your descriptions and aim for clarity and simplicity in your language to make your essay more accessible to a broad audience. prompt: Write traffic jams and housing problem (IELTS)
essay:
Traffic jam and housing issues has become major problems that could be taken by relocating big companies, industries and their workers to the rural areas. In my opinion, I agree that moving employers and factories out of cities-center which is a good solution to reduce traffic congestion and housing issues. 
 A good reason to relocate companies and their worker to the rural areas that could be reduced traffic jam is that it could decrease the population in the big cities. Nowadays, citizens often commute to work by their private car. If each person uses a car, the roads will become overload. Moreover, when they move to out of the city, they won't drive car the inner city. For example, there are a lot of companies in Bangkok, Thailand. That leads to Bangkok has one of the highest traffic congestion rate in the world. Therefore, the reduction of population in the cities-center could be addressed the traffic jam rate. 
 Another point to consider is that this solution ought to help the house price to be cheaper. The house prices are expensive in the big cities. This means workers are difficult to buy a private house and less space for poorer people. The companies move their employers out of cities that take the pressure off overcrowded cities. Take Beijing as an example, the house price is one of the most expensive in the world. However, the industries and firms move to the countryside around Beijing the house price is becoming cheaper than in the city-center. As a result, the housing problem could be solved by moving factories and workers out of the city. 
 In conclusion, the amount of vehicles on the road and the challenge of house could be addressed by moving companies to outside city that allows the reduction of population in the city and pull down the house prices.
feedback:
This essay focuses on the proposal of moving big companies, industries, and their workers to rural areas as an effective solution for addressing traffic jams and housing issues in cities. The response is relevant to the topic, presenting a clear standpoint that relocating employers and factories away from urban centers can alleviate congestion and housing problems. 

However, there are several areas where the essay could be improved to enhance clarity, correctness, and overall effectiveness:

1. **Consistency in English Variants**: It's important to use a consistent form of English throughout your essay. Considering the test's preference for British English, words like "center" should be written as "centre". Familiarizing yourself with British spelling conventions can positively impact your score.

2. **Grammar and Spelling Corrections**: There are instances where subject-verb agreement needs attention. For example, the phrase "traffic congestion rate" should be "traffic congestion rates" when implying plurality. Also, be cautious with pluralization and the construction of sentences to ensure they are grammatically correct.

3. **Formality and Style**: Academic writing typically avoids contractions. Instead of using "won't", write out "will not" to maintain a formal tone. This small adjustment can significantly improve the quality of your writing by making it appear more professional.

4. **Clarity of Argument**: While the essay outlines the benefits of relocating companies and their workers to rural areas, further elaboration and use of specific, descriptive examples could bolster your argument. The examples of Bangkok and Beijing are a good start, but expanding on these with clear, descriptive arguments and incorporating additional examples where possible could enhance your essay's persuasiveness.

5. **Point of View**: The point of view is mostly clear, as you explicitly state agreement with the proposed solution. However, stating "in my opinion" might be redundant when you've already introduced the essay with a personal pronoun. Directly asserting your views can make your statements stronger and more direct.

6. **Sentence Structure and Variety**: Experimenting with complex sentence structures can add variety to your writing and help clarify your points. Be cautious with overly long sentences, though, as they can sometimes become confusing. Balancing complex sentences with shorter, clearer ones can improve the readability of your essay.

In conclusion, the essay provides a reasonable argument for addressing urban traffic and housing challenges by relocating companies to rural areas. By focusing on the mentioned aspects, such as consistency in English variants, grammatical accuracy, and the clarity of your arguments, your essay can be significantly improved. These changes will not only help in making your position clearer but also in presenting a more polished and professional piece of writing.

prompt: Education - focusing on certain subjects or studying a wide range of subject is better?
essay:
This is my essay: 
 Some countries around the world allow students to specialize in specific subjects while in some other regions, students have a chance to learn a variety of subjects before leaving school. Both methods bring several benefits to children, but I believe that learning a wide array of subjects is better. 
 On the one hand, if students concentrate on a limited number of subjects, they can have some advantages by mastering this area. Because just focusing on fewer subjects, students can have much time to spend on them. By learning, reading, or doing exercises, the young generation who are 15 years old can have a good grasp of such subjects they focus on, they thus can apply well their knowledge into practice. Further, students have a chance to spend more time on other extracurricular activities to relax. For example, swimming or playing tennis can help students relieve stress and have a good mood for studying again. 
 On the other hand, I favour the pedagogical method of studying various subjects provides students a comprehensive education. I would argue that this system is better for three reasons. First, this educational approach helps students to broaden their knowledge in many aspects of life. History, literature can help students instill their patriotism and have thorough insights into their own culture, while maths, physics, and chemistry provide not only knowledge about science but also improve students' creativity and logic. Further, lessons that students gained from one subject can supplement another one, for instance, they can apply the way how to write a smooth essay to complete reports in Physics or Civil. Moreover, students before leaving school have opportunities to find out what they are natural talent for or what their dreams are. Because they experience many different subjects from a broad curriculum, they might know which field they are passionate about or excel at and get a tertiary education in this area. 
 In conclusion, both educational methods bring different advantages to people who are 15. I believe that studying a wide range of subjects is a better way for students to have holistic knowledge and achieve a brighter future career.
feedback:
Your essay provides a thoughtful examination of the two educational methods: specialization in specific subjects versus a broad curriculum. You conveyed your perspective clearly, arguing in favor of a diversified education. However, there are several areas in which the essay could be improved to enhance clarity, coherence, and compliance with typical essay structure expectations.

**1. Response to the Topic:**
You have appropriately addressed the topic, presenting advantages of both educational approaches before stating your preference for a broad curriculum. This shows your understanding of the debate at hand.

**2. Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues:**
Overall, your essay is well-written, but there are minor errors and stylistic choices that could be refined. For instance, it's essential to maintain consistency in the tense and ensure subject-verb agreement. Consider revising phrases like "the young generation who are 15 years old can have a good grasp" to "15-year-olds can gain a good grasp," which is more direct and avoids awkward construction. Additionally, watch out for run-on sentences and strengthen your argument by varying sentence structure for emphasis and clarity.

**3. Clarity of the Author's Point of View:**
Your point of view is clear. You favor a broad curriculum for a comprehensive education. Enhancing this viewpoint with specific, relatable examples or personal anecdotes could make your argument more compelling and relatable.

**4. Supporting Arguments:**
Your essay introduces valid points supporting both educational methods. However, to strengthen your argument further, consider organizing your essay into the recommended five paragraphs, explicitly discussing:
   - The benefits of focusing on certain subjects.
   - The benefits of studying a wide range of subjects.
   - A comparative analysis to conclude which method is superior.

This structure will provide a more balanced and comprehensive discussion on the topic. Currently, your essay combines some of these aspects, which may detract from its overall impact and clarity.

**Improvement Suggestions:**
- Adopt the five-paragraph format to ensure that each point receives adequate attention and discussion. Specifically, separate paragraphs to discuss each educational method's advantages before dedicating a distinct paragraph to your reasoned conclusion on the preferable method. This approach will not only improve content development but also task completion, as each aspect of the discussion will be thoroughly explored.
- Include a variety of examples and evidence to support your points. While you've mentioned general benefits, concrete examples or data could lend more credibility to your arguments.
- Revise for grammatical accuracy and adjust sentence structure to enhance readability. Simplify complex sentences where possible and correct any tense or agreement errors.

By addressing these points, your essay will be more structured, compelling, and in line with the expectations of a well-rounded response to the given topic. Keep practicing, and consider each piece of feedback as a step towards more effective and impactful writing.

prompt: Writing task 2; Which institution should be responsible for solving the housing shortage?

So the government should make a rule for their country to remain the population. For example, every family should only have a kid to control the daily bill and, it is enough housing supply for them to own. 
 Secondly, government can use the tax that the people pay through the daily bill to build the public house. In the modern world, everything has been taxed on, and it is a big amount of money just in a period of time so the government can spend that money to construct the public house. For instance, if people just pay 50 dollars for the tax and the country's population is 300 million it will be 15 billion dollars just to build the public house and government will sale it with the cheaper price for their resident.

prompt: IELTS task 2:children's lives were very different from today. the advantages and disadvantages

 There were a number of benefits of living in the past for the children. Firstly, they were probably happier than today because they had a simple life and they did not suffer stress from their parents for the scores in School. Secondly, they had more time with friends and families. They could learn life skills from their siblings when they played together. In addition, the kids exposed to the natural environment very soon therefore, they seemed to close to nature. 
 However, in my view, the children's lives in the past also had several important disadvantages. The living standard of the kids was affected by war and poverty. There were a lot of children who could not go to the school, which were the reason for illiteracy. They even did not have enough food so they had to work to earn money very soon. Child abuse situations were found in many companies in the past. The parents could not take care of each child and gave them the best living condition.

prompt: IELTS academic writing task 2 Some people say that children should go to school as young as possible
essay:
Studying is always said to be the most important thing in our childhood. Some people believe that children should be sent to school at an early age, while others believe the age of seven is the suitable age for children to start school. There are advantages of both ways but I agree that children should commence their studies as early as possible. 
 The primary advantage of children staying at home until 7 years old is they can spend more time with parents. Instead of sending their children to other educators, parents can spend quality time to teach and nurture their children at home. This not only strengthens the bonding between parents and children, but also gives children the most suitable education as parents are the ones understand their children's needs the most. A recent article from the University of Melbourne indicates that children prefer their parents to school teachers to teach them. In short, parents taking the role of an educator allows more parent and child time before children reach 7 years old. 
 On the other hand, children attending school at a young age promotes faster learning and development. Parents can educate their children but they are not professionally trained. Unlike school teachers, parents may not be able to incorporate pedagogy and strategy according to a child's learning milestone to facilitate learning. For instance, an early childhood educator would create a play space that stimulates an infant's sensory experience while parents do not have that knowledge to produce that experience. According to a recent research by University of Hong Kong, if toddlers are involved in a rich learning environment at school, the development of motor and language skills will be faster. 
 Nowadays, both parents have to work in most of the families. Therefore, not many of them have time to look after their children at home. In addition, even though parents are willing to spend time to teach children, the ways and methods of teaching may not be as well developed as trained teachers. Therefore, I believe sending children to school at the age of two is the most practical and beneficial decision. Parents can work to maintain a family's living while children can receive education provided by professionally recognized teachers at school.
feedback:
The essay effectively begins by restating the prompt and introducing the discussion, which helps clarify the topic under consideration. However, the development of the discussion could benefit from a more structured approach, ideally suited to a 5-paragraph format. This format typically outlines both viewpoints and your personal opinion in a balanced manner, enhancing the essay's clarity and coherence.

An essential aspect to consider is that the perspectives presented largely mirror the author's viewpoint without explicitly recognizing the range of public opinions. Incorporating phrases like "The popular opinion that..." or "In comparison to that point of view, others believe..." could help differentiate between general viewpoints and your specific stance on the subject. This differentiation not only clarifies the essay's structure but also enriches the discussion by acknowledging the diversity of opinions.

Regarding the use of references, it's pertinent to remember the limitations of the testing environment, such as the inaccessibility of the internet. While citing studies from universities lends authority to your arguments, it's practical during preparation to focus on forming arguments based on popular opinions and personal experiences. This approach ensures that your essay is supported by arguments you can confidently present under test conditions.

The essay also lacks a conclusive paragraph, leaving the discussion somewhat open-ended. Including a conclusion that summarizes the key points and your stance would provide a satisfying closure to the essay, reinforcing its central argument and ensuring it meets the Task 2 writing requirements.

On a positive note, the grammar, sentence structure, and punctuation in the essay are strong, demonstrating a good command of intermediate English. The clear paragraphs and cohesive sentences contribute to the overall readability of the essay. Nevertheless, the utilization of transition phrases could further enhance the essay's flow, creating smoother links between ideas.

Finally, incorporating a concluding paragraph is crucial. This not only adheres to the expected essay structure but also allows for a reflective summary of the discussion, offering a comprehensive closure to your argumentation.

In summary, refining the essay structure, clearly differentiating between various viewpoints, adapting the reference strategy, enhancing transitions, and ensuring a conclusive ending can significantly improve the effectiveness of your essay. These adjustments will not only strengthen your argumentation but also elevate the overall quality of your writing.

prompt: Entertainment and sport or healthcare and education

For example, wealthy nations provide financial support to medicine companies to research and create a new vaccine which can prevent the outbreak of Ebola. For instance, higher education should be either free or affordable for all those who chose to pursue a university degree. This may greatly contribute to improving the quality of workforce.

In Vietnam, for example, artists often perform plays that render the battles of our ancestors fighting against foreign invaders over the past 4000 years. This helps young generations to cultivate patriotism and national pride. Additionally, providing sports facilities such as tennis courts and football stadiums may to encourage more people to take up sports and have a healthy lifestyle. As a result, people can improve their health and build up resistance to disease. 
 In conclusion, while investing money in medical care and education has some advantages, I believe that theatres and sports stadiums play a much more important role.

prompt: More people for less traffic?
essay:

Significantly, participants in a survey conducted in Europe commented how their travel experience is negatively affected by seat unavailability of public transports. Besides, unreliable schedules due to overload of passengers might lead to an undesirable rise in the number of commuters turning to use their motorbikes and cars despite such high taxes on those vehicles. The consequential effect on national productivity is shown to be significant. In addition, car alarms seem to be a major contributor to noise pollution which affects life quality of city residents in such densely populated areas. 
 In another respect, the impact of disproportionate population allocation on economic development should be taken into account. Resources saved in decreased transportation of goods and labour forces back and forth would be converted to the rising costs of labour needed in directing the traffic flows and opportunity costs of leaving other empty areas unexploited. Furthermore, given a huge investment in redesign of urban transportation systems to ensure smooth flow of transport, increasing population means that more land is needed for new buildings, residential apartment blocks and even manufacturing factories. In other words, expansion upon roads and traffic lanes is impossible due to lack of spaces and urban planning would become much more difficult. 
 In conclusion, cities' higher population density seems to make little of a difference in a way transportation issues could be tackled, but there is evidence of its impracticality that would lead to numerous problems and make the situation even worse.
feedback:
The essay provides a clear stance on the topic, indicating disagreement with the idea that migration from suburban areas and countryside to big cities is an effective solution to traffic and transportation issues. This position is evident from the beginning, which is commendable. However, there's room for improvement in how this position is introduced and supported.

Firstly, the introduction could be strengthened by including a thesis statement. A thesis statement clearly outlines the main arguments that will be discussed in the essay. For this essay, a more developed thesis statement would specify the reasons behind the disagreement with the proposed solution, setting the stage for a more focused discussion.

In terms of content, the essay tends to veer off-topic, especially in the second paragraph. While the information provided is interesting and somewhat related to urban challenges, it's important to ensure that each paragraph directly supports the main argument. The discussion on noise pollution and the economic impact of disproportionate population allocation, for example, could be more tightly connected to the primary focus on traffic and transportation issues.

There are a few spelling, grammar, and stylistic issues to note. The phrase "seat unavailability of public transports" could be revised for clarity, perhaps to "the unavailability of seats on public transport." Similarly, "expansion upon roads and traffic lanes" might be clearer as "expanding roads and traffic lanes." Paying attention to such details can enhance the overall clarity and professionalism of the writing.

Regarding the essay's point of view, it is clear and consistently maintained throughout. However, the arguments presented would benefit from being more directly linked to the essay's central thesis. This can be achieved by routinely checking to ensure that each paragraph contributes directly to the argument being made, thereby avoiding unrelated discussions.

The conclusion effectively summarizes the essay's stance but could be more impactful with a firmer reiteration of key arguments. A more detailed conclusion that revisits the main reasons for the author's position could provide a stronger finish to the essay.

In summary, while the essay successfully communicates a clear stance on the issue, improvements can be made in developing a comprehensive thesis statement, staying on topic, addressing minor language issues, and ensuring that every part of the essay contributes directly to supporting the main argument. These adjustments will enhance the effectiveness and persuasiveness of the essay.

prompt: SOME PEOPLE THINK THAT CULTURAL TRADITIONS MAY BE DESTROYED WHEN THEY ARE USED AS MONEY-MAKING

 On the one hand, using cultural traditions to hook travelers can bring some benefits. Firstly, it is beneficial for people who rely on traditional culture for a living. For example, in Vietnam, the Dong Ho painting village is the heritage of the country; however, this traditional culture is on the verge of disappearance because dwellers cannot find enough money to make ends meet. Thus, travelers who come to this village can spend money buying paintings, which helps residents to overcome poverty. Secondly, the development of the tourism industry plays a key role in solving the unemployment problem in many countries. Specifically, this development creates many job opportunities that are linked with the tourism industry, such as tour guides and hotel staff. Thus, taking advantage of this development helps local governments to reduce the rate of joblessness. 
 On the other hand, using cultural traditions to attract tourists can lead to drawbacks. Inevitably, the development of the tourism industry is associated with the deterioration of young people about the awareness of traditional culture. To be more specific, travelers can bring their cultures, such as action movies and fashion trends, to tourist destinations. Thus, young people who absorb this novelty can ignore the cultural identity of their countries. 
 In conclusion, there are convincing arguments both for and against using traditional culture to hook the attention of travelers, but I believe that this trend still has positive impacts.
feedback:

1. **Responsiveness to the Topic**: Your essay should tackle the prompt's requirements more directly. The prompt asks for a discussion of opinions followed by your personal stance. Instead of the advantages/disadvantages format (A/D) you chose, consider structuring your essay to first discuss both viewpoints equally before concluding with your personal opinion. This structure will help ensure your essay meets the specific discussion requirements and demonstrates a clear understanding of the task.

Typically, a balanced discussion followed by a personal opinion is expected to be laid out in three reasoning paragraphs. This approach not only aids in organizing your essay more effectively but also in demonstrating your comprehension skills. It's beneficial to study sample essays to familiarize yourself with the various structures and approaches you can take.

3. **Clarity and Coherence**: Although your viewpoint is present, making it clearer and more distinct by the end of your essay will strengthen your argument. This can be achieved by dedicating a separate paragraph to your personal opinion, clearly distinguishing it from the discussion of the broader advantages and disadvantages.

4. **Spelling, Grammar, and Style**: There are minor issues with grammar and style that can be improved. Consider varying your sentence structures and utilizing a wider range of vocabulary to enhance readability and engagement. Carefully proofreading your essay or using grammar checking tools can help identify and rectify these issues.

5. **Supporting Arguments**: Your arguments are relevant and informative, especially with the use of examples such as the Dong Ho painting village. To further strengthen your essay, ensure that every argument is clearly linked back to the main topic and that your personal viewpoint is supported by compelling reasons.

By focusing on these areas for improvement, you can enhance the clarity, coherence, and responsiveness of your essay to the given topic. Remember, practice and reviewing exemplary essays are key steps in developing your writing skills. Keep up the good work, and continue refining your approach to essay writing.

prompt: In my opinion there is no need for immigrants to give up their living habits abroad
essay:
Nowadays, more people are migrating to other countries than ever before. In order to become integrated into society in thier adopted countries, immigrants should abandon their old ways and adapt to local customs and codes of behaviour. 
 Do you agree or disagree? 
 Over the past 50 years, more and more people have been choosing to live in other countries rather than staying in their native countries. It could be the pursuit of better and safer living environments, more job opportunities, or simply the desire of tasting what the other countries have to offer. However, the flood of immigrations has caused a lot of problems and controversy worldwide. Out of all the problems, whether immigrants should abandon their own practices and follow the adopted country's code is one of the most hot debate topic. Personally, I think there is no need for those immigrants to give up their living habits. They can still keep their own religions, and believe in what they believe, as long as it doesn't affect others and doesn't violate the adopted country's law. Nevertheless, it is important to note that immigrations should follow the adopted country's law, since they are now citizens there. Take a rather extreme case for example, in some countries, it is allowed for a man to marry many wives, while in other many countries this is illegal. If people migrate to a country that doesn't accept this system, they should abandon this practice. 
 However, immigration problems on this aspect can be more complicated. There are actually two kinds of immigration. One is caused by wars, political issues, or poor life conditions occuring in one's home countries. Immigrants come because of the above reasons are either minorities or have less power and resources. They are weak and , in my opinion, won't be able to influence the adopted countries' culture too much. The other type of immigrations, however, is like "investment" for rich people around the world. Nowadays, many wealthy people like to buy nationalities and migrate to other countries. Indeed, this type of immigration is the one I concern more, as these immigrants are powerful and are able to influence another country's culture, lifestyle, or even economy. For instance, Hong Kong is a popular destination for many inland Chinese to move to. Coming with their money and ambitious business minds, these wealthy people buy a lot of lands and houses in Hong Kong, and led to a fast rise in the house pricing there. Many local citizens that want to buy houses now can't afford it. 
 Therefore, when it comes to immigration issue, I think we should first distinguish this two different types, and then specifically focus on the immigration of more affluent ones. We should enact more laws to protect the wealthy from changing or dominating the adopted countries.

prompt: Ielts aging population topic - the average life expectancy is increasing
essay:
In the developed world, average life expectancy is increasing. What problems will this cause for individual and society? Suggest some measure that could be taken to reduce the impact of aging populations. 
 In recent decades, people in many countries around the world, especially those in developed countries, have enjoyed the longer longevity than ever. This trend, however, poses the burdens on society and individuals, which requires immediate actions from governments. 
 The increasing life expectancy translates problems to the workforce and healthcare system. It is obvious that the bigger the proportion of retired people who are eligible to pension payment, the smaller the number of working people who are the main contributors to social wealth and pension fund. This hinders the tax burden on working adults and the risk of pension fund deficit. Another difficulty is relate to the healthcare system. The existing healthcare facilities and workforce have become overloaded with the growing demands from the ageing population. 
 Various actions should be taken to address the issue. The first and foremost solution is to rise the working age. This would take advantage of the experienced and highly skilled elderly working people as well as prevent the risk of pension fund deficit. Secondly, law on childbirth should be enacted to encourage people to have more children. Finally, government may encourage immigration to make up for the shortage of laborers in certain fields. By doing this, the number of young adults can be increased and the economic growth driven forces can be maintained. 
 In conclusion, the longer life expectancy has lead to various drawbacks including the shortage workforce and the overload healthcare system. Therefore, government should take concrete actions in order to mitigate the aforementioned problems.

3. **Developing Paragraphs Further**: Each paragraph introduces important points but lacks depth and evidence. This approach will help in making a convincing case for the identified problems and the effectiveness of the suggested measures.

In summary, to improve this essay, focus on directly addressing the prompt in the introduction, avoiding redundancy, developing paragraphs with evidence, clarifying the argument, and correct grammatical usage. Secondly, single sports are likely to foster a sense of competition; therefore, players will be more determined, competitive.  On the other hand, playing sports in teams and groups brings a plethora of advantages to joiners. The first point is that it would raise a sense of belonging and consolidation for each participant. Indeed, when being a member of a sport team, individuals can be more unassuming, cooperative, and learn the way to obtain advice and remarks from others willingly; otherwise, people might be isolated and eliminated from the team.

prompt: The restriction of using vehicles on certain days as a way to reduce air pollution
essay:
All around the globe, air pollution has been one of the most alarming issues, especially in urban areas where many vehicles like cars used by people every day. Some suggested that we should have international car-free days, while others believe that there exist other more effective methods. From my perspective, I find that the former as the most effective way, on grounds of the release of co2 which caused air pollution mostly come from cars, though others might think that other ways are the key to stop this. 
 To begin, air pollution is already reduced by many useful methods with environmentally- friendly inventions. Most those inventions are "green" vehicles which does not have any harmful effect to the surrounding environment and it is usually run by electricity. For example, a corporation in Vietnam called Vinfast has devised a type of electric transportations used widely in my country and also worldwide. This not only helping to cut down huge amounts of CO2 emissions from private cars but also raising the awareness of community about the negative impacts of using gasoline cars. 
 On the other hand, above these suggested ways, one of the most practical and effective solutions is to have international car-free days. The more and more number of driving cars on the road, the more polluted the atmosphere is, but we can prevent it by having no cars at certain times. As a matter of fact, despite interrupting the development of transportations, the benefits of this way are undeniable. And the most obvious advantage is that the amount of toxic gases is no longer emitted enormously on that day. 
 In conclusion, there are several detrimental factors which lead to air pollution and many methods have been recommended to reduce this problem, such as using environmentally-friendly transportations but i believe the restriction of using vehicles on certain days is the most effective and practical way.

Furthermore, the essay falls short in distinguishing between public discourse and your own perspective. In discussions that entail comparing various viewpoints, clarity is crucial. When arguing for the effectiveness of car-free days, including more explicit comparisons to the alternatives mentioned could strengthen your position. In conclusion, while the essay establishes a clear stance on the topic of air pollution and proposes an interesting solution, refining the introduction for brevity, enhancing clarity in presenting multiple viewpoints, correcting language errors, and deepening the analysis and comparison of different solutions will make your argument more convincing and well-rounded.

feedback:

prompt: IELTS2 - Government should increase the cost of fuel for cars and other vehicles to save environment
essay:
Increase fuel cost to tackle environmental problems 
 TOPIC 
 : People think that government should increase the cost of fuel for cars and other vehicles to solve environmental problems. Give your opinion. 
 Protecting the ecosystem is the authorities' top priority mission these days. While other people think that raising taxes on petrol is the most effective solution, I would argue that there are other better ways to combat the issue. 
 To begin with, fuel being increased in cost alone does not bring huge changes in the usage of cars and other fuel-based vehicles. At recent, there are little choice of transport so people have to drive their personal vehicles for daily activities. If the cost goes up, they still do not have alternative transport and keep using petrol-based ones. Moreover, in some countries lacking of developed public transport system and citizens continue to travel by private cars, when the fuel fee rises, they are forced to spend more money on it and reduce budget for other eco-friendly products such as glass containers or cloth bags and using free plastic instead which is another pressing pollution. 
 In addition, the government should invest more money to upgrade the public transport provision which plays a pivotal role in tackling the problem. As the service on buses and underground trains does not meet the standard quality, people are less willing to try public vehicles. For example, in comparison with Vietnam, Australia has a more efficient transport system that becomes an indispensable part of people life. Thus, the quantity of private cars and motors dramatically decline. The air quality in Australia is much fresher and safer for its netizen thanks to the fact that less vehicles produce less gases and traffic congestion occurring as well. 
 In conclusion, the idea of raising fuel cost is not suitable for today situation and improving public transport quality is considered to be more effective. The national authorities should allocate more fund in traffic in order to preserve the planet's environment.
feedback:
Your essay, focusing on whether increasing fuel costs is an effective way to tackle environmental problems, provides a clear stance that there are better ways than raising fuel prices. However, there are several aspects that could be improved to make your essay stronger and more responsive to the task.

1. **Response to the Topic:**
   It's crucial to ensure that your essay directly addresses the prompt given. The prompt asks you to discuss to what extent you agree or disagree with the idea that raising the price of fuel is the best way to solve environmental issues. Your essay should more clearly state your position in relation to this specific statement. Make sure to directly acknowledge the prompt in your introduction and rephrase it to show you understand what you are being asked.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues:**
   Pay attention to grammatical errors and sentence structure to enhance the readability of your essay. For instance, 
   - It's important to maintain consistent tense throughout your essay.
   - Refrain from using informal language ("raising taxes on petrol is the most effective solution").
   - Watch out for typos and missing words ("lacking of developed public transport system" should be "lack of a developed public transport system").
   Ensure sentences are clear and concise. Avoid long sentences that might confuse the reader.

3. **Clarity of Author’s Point of View:**
   Your point of view is evident but could be stated more explicitly in the introduction. Directly stating whether you agree or disagree with the prompt and briefly outlining your main arguments will strengthen your introduction. This sets a clear path for the reader and ensures your stance is understood from the beginning.

4. **Arguments and Support:**
   Your essay presents arguments against raising fuel costs, emphasizing the lack of alternative transport and the need for better public transport systems. These arguments are good but need to be clearer and more detailed. For each point you make:
   - Instantly state how it relates to the question of fuel prices and environmental problems.
   - Use specific examples to support your claims. For example, comparing the public transport systems of Vietnam and Australia is helpful, but more detail on how improvements in public transport can directly impact environmental problems would be stronger.
   - Explain your reasoning fully. For instance, when discussing the increased financial burden on consumers, delve deeper into how this affects their ability to engage in eco-friendly practices.

In sum, sharpen your focus on directly addressing the prompt, clean up grammatical and spelling errors, clearly state your point of view from the outset, and provide more detailed arguments with specific examples. By making these adjustments, your essay will be better structured, more persuasive, and more directly responsive to the task at hand.

prompt: Working in groups proves to be more efficient than working individually
essay:
Soft-skills are non-technical skills that are relate to how you work, how you interact with colleagues and how you become successfully. In this case, working in groups is believed and demonstrated to be more and more efficient than working by yourself because of its time-saving and skills-providing benefits. 
 As you know, the power of community is always stronger than that of an individual. In a team, each number is in charge of a certain part while a single is responsible for the whole task. As a result, working together's workload is not as much of that in working alone as well as the working procedure is being shortened. 
 In addition, working in group is not only sparing in time, but also improve one's professional competence. Each member get an opportunity to strengthen his or her cooperation capability, leadership skill and problem solving ability. Moreover, listening to others' point of view and summarize their contributions can widen knowledge and provide one's experiences. 
 In conclusion, working on groups proves to be more useful than working individually for notably three noticeable reasons. This soft-skill is an effective and powerful way to learn and achieve success which everyone needs to equip in daily life.
feedback:
The essay discusses the benefits of working in groups, highlighting how it can be time-saving and provide opportunities to develop soft skills such as cooperation, leadership, and problem-solving abilities. This topic aligns well with discussions about the importance of soft skills in the workplace. However, there are several areas where the essay could be improved for clarity and effectiveness.

Firstly, it’s important to clearly define the main topic and how each part of the essay relates to it. The introduction transitions from discussing soft skills to the benefits of working in groups without clearly explaining how these ideas are connected. To improve, try linking soft skills directly to group work by explaining that working in groups can enhance these skills, making this connection explicit from the start.

There are also assumptions made that could confuse readers who are not familiar with the topic. For example, the essay assumes the reader understands why working in groups is more efficient without offering detailed examples or explanations. To make the essay more informative and easier to follow, include specific examples of how group work can save time and develop professional competence.

- Instead of "how you become successfully," consider "how you become successful."
- The word "number" in the phrase "each number is in charge" is unclear; "member" would be a more appropriate term.

- Be consistent with terminology, choosing either "working in groups" or "working on groups" and sticking with it throughout the essay.

Moreover, the point of view of the essay author should be clearly stated. The current essay leans towards an informative tone but occasionally slips into a more persuasive approach without firmly taking a stance. Decide whether the essay’s primary goal is to inform the reader about the benefits of group work or to persuade them of its superiority over individual work, and adjust the tone accordingly.

To strengthen the arguments, the essay could benefit from more detailed descriptions and examples. For instance, illustrating a specific scenario where group work saved time or significantly enhanced someone's soft skills would make the arguments more compelling and relatable.

In conclusion, focusing on explicitly connecting the discussion of soft skills to the benefits of group work, providing clear and specific examples, and addressing the grammatical and stylistic issues will make the essay more coherent and engaging. This approach will help ensure that the essay is informative and easy to understand, avoiding assumptions that might confuse readers who are not already knowledgeable about the topic.

prompt: Should students study the science of food and how to prepare it or not? Discuss both views
essay:
Some people argue that students should focus on learning about food. However, this idea was opposed by those who suppose food is not considered as a main subject and encourage students to study other subjects. Personally, I agree with the latter viewpoint because food is such a broad subject for kids to learn throughout the school term. 
 To some extent, encouraging students to study the science of food is reasonable. Firstly, food is a necessity in our lives, no one can survive without it. Therefore, many individuals believe learning about food would be useful for children and assist them in becoming independent people. Next, cooking food also fosters the youngster's creativity and other soft skills. Based on those public opinions, I must admit that food plays an significant role in life, but I am still doubtful whether students should focus on it instead of studying other subjects. 
 With the second argument, people think pupils should spend time on more critical subjects rather than food. They suppose the primary subjects are Math, Literature, Physics, Chemistry, etc. Food is such a wide topic that no one can cover through limited time at school, so it should be an optional course that students can choose to take. Furthermore, today's children can learn about food in a variety of ways, such as from their parents' dishes or via the Internet. As a result, children should devote time to learning subjects that they would be unable to learn outside of school. Based on what has been said so far, I totally agree with this argument, as pupils can learn about food outside of school hours. 
 In conclusion, there are two opposing angles on whether students should spend time learning about food or other subjects at school. However, I believe that pupils should concentrate on essential courses at school and use their free time studying about food.
feedback:
To improve your essay, it's essential to accurately reflect the topic and all points of view involved. Your introduction partially captures the debate around whether students should focus on learning about food. However, it misses an important distinction: the debate includes learning about food's nutritional aspects and learning how to prepare food. These are two different areas, and addressing both would strengthen your response to the topic.

When presenting the opposing view, it's better to state it as their genuine belief rather than something they "suppose." This will make your argument more respectful and accurate.

Your essay follows a good discussion format, but there's room for better development of your personal opinion. Instead of saying "we" or "our," which suggests you're speaking for a group, use "I" to express your individual opinion more clearly. Also, instead of only stating whether you agree or disagree, delve deeper into why you hold that opinion by relating it more directly to the discussion points. This makes your stance stronger and your argument more convincing.

Be cautious of the word count and strive for concise writing. This essay exceeds the typically allowed word count, which doesn't necessarily strengthen your argument but instead increases the chance of errors that could detract from your overall score.

Finally, take time to review and edit your work before submission. This process can help identify and correct errors, ensuring that your essay is as strong as possible. Implementing these suggestions will not only make your discussion more comprehensive and clear but also enhance the overall quality and effectiveness of your essay.

prompt: Technology leads to the unavoidable shifting of the interactions between people - writing task 2
essay:

 First of all, in a positive area, the three significant representatives of the technological achievements - mobile phones, computers, and the internet have simplified our conversational and collaborative interactions. The relationships built from these types of interactions benefit, too. 
 In the social context, people are more active in enlarging their social network by seeing and making friends with those who share common interests with them via social media. Besides, the conversations between friends and family members are kept continuous and instant via mobile phone and internet, hence enhancing their bonds. It is the same in working context, face to face meeting is no longer as compulsory as it used to be for a group of colleagues running a project. Moreover, the defined goals are better reached through collaboration leveraging the advance of technology such as shared information systems. In the educational context, online teaching via the internet requires less direct interaction between teachers and students as they can learn from video recordings and other open sources. 
 On the other hand, to some degree, those we call "virtual interaction" may impair the ability to communicate in real life, especially the youngsters as some of them are isolating themselves on social media and avoid their actual lives. This discouraging real interactions habit is negatively affecting the social bond, in general. Once relationships are all maintained in that way, they will become seriously vulnerable. 
 In short, technology has revolutionized the interactions between people, yet it can't warrant total positive outcomes.
feedback:
The essay explores the impact of technology on human interactions and nicely outlines both the positive and negative effects that come with technological advancement. However, to make your essay stronger and more aligned with the expectations of an English proficiency test, consider focusing on the following aspects:

1. **Response to the Topic**: It's crucial to take a clear stance on the topic. You have discussed both sides – the benefits and drawbacks of technology on human interactions. While understanding both perspectives is valuable, for this type of essay, you should choose one position and defend it strongly with convincing arguments. This will make your essay more focused and compelling.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Style Issues**: Your essay is mostly free from spelling and grammar errors, which is great. However, pay attention to the flow and transition between paragraphs to ensure your ideas are well-connected and easy to follow. Using transition words and phrases can help improve the readability of your essay.

3. **Clarity of the Author's Point of View**: As mentioned, your point of view regarding whether technology's impact on human interactions is predominantly positive or negative is somewhat unclear. A strong essay should express a clear opinion and stick with it throughout the piece. Decide which side of the argument you support more and make that the focus of your essay.

4. **Support for the Position**: While you have provided examples of how technology affects human interactions, your arguments would be stronger with more specific details and examples. When you choose your stance, support it with two solid reasons and expand on those with detailed examples, statistics, or studies. This will not only strengthen your argument but also show your critical thinking and analytical skills.

Remember, there is no "right" or "wrong" side to choose; what matters is how well you defend your chosen position. This approach will not only clarify your opinion but also make your argument more persuasive. Lastly, simplicity is key, especially for English language learners. Make sure your language is straightforward and your arguments are easily understandable. Keep practicing, and consider these tips to refine your writing further.

prompt: Ielts Writing task 2 : Studying abroad - Discuss both views
essay:
Discuss both sides of the argument and give your own opinion 
 It is true that nowadays there is the ubiquitousness of studying overseas among students. Advocates of this trend claim that it offers various advantages while opponents assert studying abroad may cause some fundamental consequences. In my point of view, I believe that its benefit may eclipse its drawbacks. 
 On one hand, it is true that students have to confront a wide range of problems when they live in another country. The economic burden is the first demerit. Studying abroad is associated with many costs including tuition fees, travel expenses, and cost of living, which may lead to student debt. Another issue students have to encounter is homesickness. Students are obligated to live far from their hometown when studying overseas. As a result, the state of homesickness always occurs affecting negatively their education performance. Moreover, they may hesitate to communicate due to the unfamiliar, this may harm their mental health. 
 Having said that, I believe studying abroad delivers many benefits. Firstly, it may enhance the practical skills of students. Living in another country requires people to learn a new language for the sake of interacting with locals, therefore, ex-pats are forced to practice their language skills on a daily basis. As a result, they can reach a professional level in using the native language. Moreover, when students study in another country, they have to build their life by themselves, which promotes their independence, self-reliance, and maturity. Secondly, it would appear students who study in a foreign country have more job prospects. Having studied abroad, students have chances to experience a brand-new country with a novel culture contributing to developìng a more sophisticated worldview. This view helps them become more easily adaptable to situations requiring international interaction Based on the conducted research, eighty percent of the overseas students said that studying abroad allowed them to work in diverse environments. Needless to say, it is a great advantage regarding attracting employers, especially in the globalized world nowadays. 
 In conclusion, studying abroad contains both pros and cons. In my perspective, its potential benefits in terms of personal growth and career opportunities heavily overweigh its drawbacks. However, students who intend to study abroad still should have good preparation mentally and financially to confront unexpected situations
feedback:
Your essay on the topic of studying abroad and the discussion of its pros and cons presents a well-thought-out opinion. However, there are several areas where improvements can make your essay stronger and more aligned with the expectations of an English proficiency test essay. Below is a detailed feedback aimed at guiding you through these improvements.

1. **Response to the Topic:**
Your essay engages with the topic by discussing both the advantages and disadvantages of studying abroad. However, your presentation of personal opinion could be improved. It's better to present your opinion after discussing each public point of view separately rather than stating it at the beginning. This approach ensures clarity and allows you to provide a more balanced discussion before sharing your stance. You are expected to assess both sides objectively before giving your judgment.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues:**
The essay is generally well-written, but vigilance in proofreading could enhance its readability and professionalism. Be particularly attentive to spelling errors (e.g., "developìng" should be "developing"), and consider the impact of sentence structure on your essay's clarity. Using simpler language can help make your arguments more accessible to all readers.

3. **Clarity of Point of View:**
Your point of view is clear, but how you arrive at it could be refined. Rather than declaring your opinion upfront, develop it gradually through the essay. This way, the reader can follow your thought process and understand why you side with one argument more than the other. Remember, your personal insight and individual reasoning add value to your opinion.

4. **Arguments and Support:**
While you do provide arguments for both sides of the discussion, there's room for deeper exploration. Each point of view should be equally discussed and substantiated with examples or personal knowledge. Simply listing benefits and drawbacks without this depth makes the essay feel less developed. Aim to show understanding and critical analysis of each viewpoint by discussing why you support or do not support a specific argument, rather than just stating it.

**Additional Recommendations:**
- **Planning and Structure:** Before writing, spend some time planning your essay. Draft an outline that includes an introduction, a balanced body discussing both viewpoints, and a conclusion where your opinion is clearly stated. This planning phase ensures you cover all required aspects and maintain a logical flow.
- **Format and Presentation:** Adhere closely to the expected essay format. Your introduction should set the scene; the body should explore arguments; and your conclusion should tie everything together, presenting your stance. Avoid formatting errors by checking your essay against the task instructions.

Remember, each point made should be supported by a specific example or evidence. This detail will enrich your essay and make your arguments convincing. Furthermore, reflecting on each argument critically and providing your personal insight will make your essay stand out.

In conclusion, your essay demonstrates a good effort in tackling a complex issue. By refining your approach to presenting your opinion, ensuring balance and depth in your arguments, and improving the technical aspects of your writing, you'll greatly enhance the quality of your essay. Keep practicing, and consider each essay as an opportunity to improve your writing skills.

prompt: It is difficult for people living in cities today get enough physical exercise. Causes & solutions.
essay:
The lack of physical exercise has gained popularity in many countries in recent decades, particularly citizens living in towns. Though this issue can be contributed for some reasons, there may be a feasible solution. 
 There are some reasons why the people of urban areas have no time to do the practice. First, living expenses are quite expensive in towns, so every adult always struggles with financial burden and they have to get stuck with work all day long to solve living expenses. They find it hard, with a tight schedule, to spend lots of time doing exercise. Second, the entertainment media in the city that people are just sitting somewhere and enjoying have improved massively. In fact, these attractive products such as computer games, movies can attract both the young generation and the old generation so they don't want to do recreational activities. 
 This problem has a few possible solutions. First, the government can take some measures to make people aware of the benefits of physical exercise like yoga, gym, etc. Because people would spend more time doing exercise since they recognize the importance of this. Second, the advertising campaign should be more attractive for people excited about gymnasiums, yoga, and some related activities. Actually, if people are interested in this advertisement, they tend to spend time and money to participate in it. 
 In conclusion, with a busy lifestyle in urban centers, more and more people are not getting enough time to exercise physically. But we should spend a lot of time doing the exercise because of our health benefits from these.
feedback:
Your essay addresses the topic of physical exercise's diminishing role in urban areas, which is a good start. It's clear that you understand the importance of discussing both the causes and possible solutions related to this issue. However, to enhance your essay and make it more effective, let's go over some areas where improvements could be made.

First, it's crucial to closely stick to the prompt's instructions. The prompt focuses on urban residents, but your essay starts by mentioning many countries before narrowing down to towns. This wider approach could distract from the main point and affect your task achievement score, as it might seem like you're deviating from the given topic. Directly addressing the causes and solutions related to urban areas right from the beginning would strengthen your argument and maintain relevance to the prompt.

In discussing the reasons for the lack of physical exercise, connecting your ideas logically will help in creating a more coherent argument. For instance, if financial constraints are a reason for not exercising, it seems contradictory to then say entertainment expenses are prioritized. A more cohesive approach might discuss how after long working hours, those who might afford gym memberships find facilities closed or are too exhausted to attend. This connection between reasons offers clearer insight into the problem and makes your reasoning more persuasive.

Your essay's language and style could also be refined for academic writing. Avoid casual terms like "etc." and starting sentences with "because." These detract from the formal tone expected in such essays. Remember to also use punctuation like commas correctly to clearly separate clauses and improve readability. And rather than using contractions such as "don't," spell out the full words ("do not") to maintain a formal tone.

Finally, the introduction of solutions is a good move, but make sure these are described in a way that genuinely addresses the identified causes. Encouraging awareness and advertising could indeed make a difference, but explaining how these solutions specifically tackle the challenges faced by urban residents would make your argument stronger. For example, you could suggest fitness programs that cater to busy schedules or are financially accessible to a wider audience.

By focusing on these areas—sticking closely to the prompt, connecting your arguments clearly, refining your writing style, and offering targeted solutions—you can significantly enhance the quality of your essay and better convey your understanding of the topic.

prompt: Essay about setting homework to students with positive and negative views - IELTS task 2
essay:
The perspective on setting homework to students is one of the most controversial schooling topics. Many people claimed that it is a positive development for children to be given homework. While other disagree with this idea, I believe it is a necessary aspect of education which supports students in improving their independent learning and problem solving skills 
 On the one hand, it is believed that homework is an unnecessary burden on children. Children spend most of their time at school to study, thus doing further study at home will be a high pressure on them. In addition, they only concentrate on the way to finish homework without participate in any physical activities such as playing basketball, swimming, so forth, which negatively impacts on balance between children physical and mental improvement. Moreover, students in top international education countries where homework is not necessity, taking children in Finland as an example for this, still outperform peers in nations where setting homework is the norm. 
 On the other hand, I argue in favour of the view that homework has an important role to play in the schooling children. There are two reasons supporting this idea. Firstly, it contributes to enhance self-learning skill. When doing homework, children will figure out an exercise that they cannot complete well by themselves. As this result, they will review lessons or search the way to complete it on the Internet. Secondly, students will find some solutions to fulfill a task such as discussing with teachers or their classmates then summarizing the problems in order to discover an answer. This process helps them improve issue tackling skill. Therefore, children would be more independent and dealing with challenges easily comparing with peers who do not practice these skills which bring great success into their adult life. 
 To conclude, there are some adverse effects on having a further study at home. However, I strongly contended that if we minimize these negative consequences, giving out homework will be a major benefit to students
feedback:
Your essay offers a perspective on the controversial issue of assigning homework to students. You present arguments for and against, and ultimately, you express your position in support of homework due to its benefits for students' learning and problem-solving skills. While your effort is commendable, there are several areas for improvement to better meet the requirements of English proficiency tests. 

Firstly, it is crucial that your essay directly responds to the topic by discussing all relevant points of view before sharing your personal opinion. Your essay currently introduces your stance too early without fully exploring alternative viewpoints. A more structured approach could involve:
1. Starting with a neutral introduction that paraphrases the topic without revealing your opinion.
2. Presenting the first public opinion on homework's negative impact.
3. Discussing the second public opinion on the positives of homework.
4. Introducing your personal perspective, supported by reasons, to align with one of the previously mentioned public views.
5. Concluding with a summary of your reasoning, reinforcing your stance.

In terms of spelling, grammar, and style, your essay is mostly clear, but some sentences could be refined for clarity and coherence. For example, consider simplifying complex sentences and ensuring smooth transitions between ideas. Additionally, paying attention to verb tense consistency and avoiding generalizations would enhance your essay's accuracy and professionalism.

Your point of view is apparent, but as mentioned, the structured comparison of differing viewpoints before revealing your own would strengthen your analytical presentation. This approach not only clarifies your position but also demonstrates your ability to critically evaluate multiple perspectives.

Moreover, while you provide reasons supporting your view, these arguments could be further enriched with examples, evidence, or more detailed explanations. This depth would convincingly illustrate how homework contributes to self-learning and problem-solving skills, thereby supporting your conclusion more robustly.

In summary, focus on arranging your essay to thoroughly examine all relevant perspectives before presenting your own. Aim to clarify your arguments with more specific examples and ensure your writing is grammatically clean and stylistically fluid. Following these suggestions would undoubtedly enhance the quality and persuasive power of your essays in future English proficiency tests.

prompt: [IELTS Writing] Increasing number of consumed sugar-based drinks? Why? What can be done to reduce?

more sugar-based drinks in the market than ever 
 Coming out as one of the highest caught illness in the world - diabetics has raised a number of concerns among health experts but clearly not the consumers. As the quantity of consumed sugar-based drinks continues increasing intensively. This essay will discuss the possible reasons and suggest solutions to tackle the aforementioned situation. 
 Factors contributing to the growth of sweat drinks consuming rate varies widely to different parties including manufactures, advertisements and consumers themselves. The size of the market providing bottled drinks is getting larger every day, there are more than one thousand types of drinks being sold in supermarkets, automatic drink booths installed in public and universities. With the power of advertisements which provides false information of nutrition values of those drinks, combined with its convenience and availability, sweetened drinks attract customers at every age. Leading as a part of this is the subjective attitude of people who not only do not considerately search for true values of this drink but also ignore the advice of doctors and helpful news from reliable sources. As the consumers have the tendency of favoring cheap and tasty drinks rather than paying more to get healthy expensive drinks. 
 Fortunately, this situation can be addressed by various measures. There should be stricter and transparent conditions of advertising control towards sugar-based drinks, whereby the information broadcasted would be less exaggerated, which also helps to reduce the number of advertisements. Therefore, when it comes to decisions, customers would not affected by the curiosity raised by watching advertisements, and consider the drinks based on the actual quality.
