 To begin with, it is undeniable that studying arts and musical classes aid to cultivate students' imagination from an very early age. This is due to the fact that it provide learners opportunities to access aesthetic works throughout historical length, which expanding students' knowledge and way of thinking. In addition, activities such as drawing, singing, etc require creative brain. By repeating these actions, humans can, definitely, foster their inventiveness. Given in research conducted by professors in Cambridge University, they asked children in a primary school to take a test of creativity. Unsurprisingly, children who have paid more attention in art or music classes show a better sense of availability to deal with different situations. 
 On top of that, making art and music classes obligatory creates more chances to students to relieve stress. After learning such intensive academic subjects, attending classes such as painting can be relaxing. This is because these activities do not force neurons to work overly, moreover, its ability in reducing pressure has been substantiated. As can be seen in therapy for patients with autism or psychological trauma, the treating for these patients often comprises of drawing or playing musical instruments on the ground that peaceful pictures or sounds can ease internal damage. 
 In conclusion, if art and music classes are attended regularly, it can markedly demonstrates its essence in bolstering humans' imagination, eliminating negative thoughts too. All things considered, these types of classes should not be overlooked.

prompt: IELTS2: Idea that students should be allowed to study with people who have the same capacity as them
essay:
SOME PEOPLE THINK THAT SCHOOLS SHOULD SELECT STUDENTS ACCORDING TO THEIR ACADEMIC ABILITIES, WHILE OTHERS BELIEVE THAT IT IS BETTER TO HAVE STUDENTS WITH DIFFERENT ABILITIES STUDYING TOGETHER. DISCUSS BOTH VIEWS AND STATE YOUR OWN OPINION 
 In this day and age, the number of students who have great academic performance despite their age is rising at an unprecedented rate. While some people advocate the idea that students should be allowed to study with people who have the same capacity as them, others agree that a class should have students with different academic abilities. The following essay with discuss both views and raise the author's voice 
 On the one hand, arranging classes with students who share equal potential can bring about an array of benefits. One of the pros is that it will be extremely time-saving for prestigious students who want to go the extra mile in both their study as well as their future careers. It can be illustrated by the fact that in spite of learning something that they already understand with ordinary students, they can nurture their raw talent by studying with a specific pedagogy with people who are on the same level as them. Therefore, they can achieve a myriad of successes in their study from a very young age and can contribute greatly to society 
 On the other hand, there are also some merits to be gained when having students with a wide range of academic levels in the same class. First and foremost, gifted students can support their counterparts with lower study levels by instructing or providing knowledge since they might find it hard to comprehend some kind of lecture. Thereby, not only low-educated students can understand the lesson properly but also smart ones can revise it by reteaching it to others. Furthermore, if well-educated students are permitted to take high-level classes, they might graduate and find a job sooner than their friends, which may be really stressful for them when it comes to communicating with co-workers, mainly due to the lack of essential social skills and age barriers 
 In conclusion, while I agree that studying with same-level students can save time and make students gain a lot of achievements when they are still young, I also subscribe to the notion that combining students with various academic abilities also have many advantages.
feedback:

prompt: Horizontal city or vertical city

From a personal perspective, I am inclined to side with living in a city which is developed upwards, although the other school of design may benefit the residents in specific aspects as well. 
 To commence, proponents of low-rise housing ground their argument in the merit of safety and freedom. Firstly, detached houses are generally safer than high-rise apartments due to the basic nature of each structure, which facilitates the escape from the buildings or victim-seeking process when a fire occurs. Meanwhile, in terms of sky-high constructions, fighting fire is such a daunting task considering not all buildings offer an effective evacuation plan or sufficient escape routes. Moreover, some mega-structures are vulnerable to natural incidents and may not be able to withstand earthquakes and hurricanes, jeopardizing the lives of occupants and causing irreversible damage to the neighboring region. The earthquake striking Turkey in February is a salient example, which led to the mortalities of over 20,000 people and the collapse of thousands of high-rises0.  In contrast, the cities that are vertically expanded can effectively address the natural resource depletion by combining recreational parks or shopping malls as built-in amenities, not to mention other amusement services in the proximity, hence enhancing convenience and amounting to increased economic productivity. Furthermore, the context of exponential increase in population and housing shortage can be a driving force behind the extravagant cost of land and construction for low-rises, let alone the recurring maintenance expenses, which heighten the financial burden for the majority. Therefore, I believe that growing municipalities upwards is a more viable approach since it can maximize land use efficiency, accommodating significantly more inhabitants compared to the same footprint of low-rise buildings.

prompt: Loss of plants and animals vs other major environmental issues
essay:

 It is believed by some that the primary environmental issue faced by humans is the last of specific species of plants and animals, while others believe that there are graver environmental issues. While the disappearance of certain species can result in a rise in certain illnesses, there are more crucial environmental issues faced by humans, such as air pollution. 
 On the one hand, the disappearance of some species can lead to widespread diseases caused by some animals. This is because those species feed upon certain animals and plants that are dangerous to people. Their disappearance will exponentially increase the population of these animals and the diseases they transmit. For example, in Italy, they conducted an experiment in which they got rid of cats in one of their cities. This led to an overpopulation of rats throughout that city and led to a spike in rat-borne illnesses. However, I disagree that this is the biggest environmental threat because there are technological remedies that can address this issue. 
 On the other hand, it is thought that air pollution is the gravest issue that humans have to deal with. This is because there has been a significant increase in activities that contribute negatively to the environment in recent times. There are several factories setup in every country that release toxic gases into the atmosphere, which makes the air harmful for us to breathe and can result in several health complications, such as lung and heart diseases. For example, the NHS reports admitting several patients each year for preventable lung conditions who live closer to such factories. Therefore, I agree with this view because it is detrimental to one's health. 
 In conclusion, even though the extinction of some species can result in an increase in certain diseases, the pollution of the air is more crucial and should be dealt with at the earliest.

prompt: IELTS Writing task 2 - Technology's effects on social relationships
essay:
Recent advances in technology have revolutionized public association in various ways around the world. Consequently, it is highly contentious that modern communication technology poses a dire threat to the relationships amongst people. From my perspective, though I lean towards the aforementioned statement, we also should not disregard its potential benefits accompanied by its drawbacks. 
 On the one hand, virtual communication has its own merits. The first advantage is that it allows great flexibility, which removes all geographical and time barriers. It means that people in different locations and time zones can instantly connect with each other via the Internet, so that it builds up and augment existing social ties. To illustrate, in the past, people had to make long trips just to meet other partners from other companies; however, with online meetings, they can join the conference from any place without the need to travel, which not only facilitates collaboration but also helps them to save time and money. Secondly, innovations in communication allows greater chance for new relationships as well as expanding our social circles. Music fandoms, which are the special community established by numerous people from different backgrounds all over the world, well exemplify this. By sharing the same interest and admiration to their idols, they become friends and may find out other mutually common things. 
 On the flip side, modern communication has detrimental impacts on social relationships. Discouraging direct communication is the first negative consequence. A vast majority of individuals are frequently online to check notifications from various applications that they use for communication, and they spent longer time on their gadgets than socializing in person with their peers, workmates, and families. Consequently, their relationship with the society and people are being ruined because of their isolation with the environment. In addition, it is believed that advanced technology in the field of communication can wreck the nature of friendship. Often virtual friends are not reliable and there is little likelihood of maintaining a long relationship with these people. There are many people who were swindled out of hundreds of dollar by their online friends because these swindlers made friends with them in order to merely take advantage of them. 
 In conclusion, though the modern technology is convenient, I strongly believe that people should control their use of technology due to a variety of its negative effects, and never forget the essentials of personal interaction.

prompt: The time that family members spend gathering to have meals is reducing

The time that family members spend gathering to have meals is indeed reducing. While it is necessary to identify the possible cause of this trend, it is also essential to predict the effects on children and their health. 
 There are two primary reasons why nowadays family members tend to not have meals together. Firstly, parents are usually busy with work. Some families need two incomes for financial stability so both fathers and mothers have to spend a large amount of time at work. All the stress accumulated during the working day often makes it difficult to have lunches or dinners at home. For instance, employees usually work 8 to 12 hours a day at the office, so they tend to buy their lunches rather than going back home to ensure their working time. Secondly, in some extended families, members do not get along with each other. Nowadays there are three or even four generations in a house. The age gap is getting bigger between family members, which leads to difficulties relating to each other. 
 Several negative impacts on children are being witnessed due to this phenomenon. A lack of family meals can make children feel abandoned. Unlike surfing the web or playing computer games, having meals is often a whole-family activity. If parents do not spend enough time taking care of their kids' meals, family bonds will be weakened and children therefore will feel left behind. Moreover, this trend also has a harmful impact on children's health. Family meals were an opportunity to provide a healthy diet for all family members. Without the supervision of parents, children tend to eat junk food, snacks, or other fast food for their lunches or dinners. This will lead to many serious health diseases such as obesity and hyperactivity in the long term. 
 In conclusion, some reasons can be identified for the decline in shared family meals and the impacts are seriously harmful.
feedback:

It's important to focus on the task at hand without inserting personal opinions or unnecessary affirmations. For example, stating "The time that family members spend gathering to have meals is indeed reducing" could be simplified to directly address the causes and effects without affirming it as the writer's belief. Ensure that each paragraph has a clear focus that ties back to the question prompt directly.

For instance, consider varying sentence structure to make the text more engaging. Also, pay attention to maintaining a formal and academic tone throughout.

3. **Point of View Clarity:** Your essay does clearly present a viewpoint, highlighting causes for reduction in family meals and its impacts on children. However, making your thesis statement more explicit at the beginning can help readers understand your stance from the outset.

However, the connection between some of your points and the topic could be clearer. For example, when discussing the age gap in extended families, explicitly explain how it contributes to decreasing family meals. Further, incorporating more specific examples or data could strengthen your arguments.

Remember, supporting each claim with clear, relevant examples will make your essay more persuasive. Additionally, the conclusion should comprehensively summarize the points discussed while also meeting the word count requirement to avoid any deductions. Expanding on how these trends could be addressed or reversed in your concluding paragraph could also provide a more robust ending to the essay.

Improving on these aspects will not only make your essay more coherent and directly aligned with the topic but also help in conveying your points more persuasively to the reader. Keep practicing, and consider these points in your future essays to enhance your writing skills.

Because of that, we had wasted lots of time just to write letters, send them and then receive the replies. However, at the moment, sending messages only takes a few second, either it can be form of an email or messages of some applications of the smartphone. We can send and receive messages straightway. prompt: IELTS Part 2 - Overseas visitors should follow local customs and behaviors.
essay:
There is no doubt that the people from each and every country have unique characteristics and way of living. But when they visit to other countries, some people believe that they should have to follow the local people's behaviour whereas I believe that it is not necessary. 
 Firstly, visitors from other countries would get influenced by the local people's way of speech and behaviour. This is because, when both set of people get into interaction, out of interest, without knowingly the visitors start to learn things happening around. For example, when foreigners visiting India, they learnt and greet people by joining hands in front their chest instead of handshake. So the visitors have opportunity to broaden up their knowledge from these basic behaviours to the extent they can. In contrast to that, if they couldn't find anything fascinated then they hardly follow those stuffs. 
 However, I believe that it is not essential for every visitor to learn new behaviour and lifestyle from other country. This is because, most commonly visitors stay for shorter period and they don't have to follow everything what local people do. On considering these elements, tourism industries progressively make arrangements for them to feel home away from home because these restrictions may decrease their growth. Conversely, if a visitor planned for long stay then they will learn to follow local customs and behaviours for survival without imposing it on to them. 
 In conclusion, although visitors from other country get influenced by local people's behaviour and it can broaden their knowledge, it is not necessary for them to follow it.
feedback:
Your essay on how visitors should adapt to local customs presents a clear stance but has room for improvement in structure, focus, and language use. Here's how:

**1. Topic Response and Clarity:**
You've chosen an interesting topic about whether visitors to a country should adopt local behaviors. Your position is evident as you argue against the necessity for visitors to assimilate fully. However, ensure your thesis statement stands alone and is clearly articulated at the end of your introduction for greater impact. Refine this to directly address the essay prompt without merging it with background information.

**2. Structure and Argumentation:**
Your essay structure needs attention. Each paragraph should serve a specific purpose in supporting your viewpoint. Instead of juxtaposing contrasting viewpoints within the body paragraphs, streamline your focus solely on arguments that reinforce your stance. Misaligning paragraphs with the essay’s thesis detracts from its coherence and risks losing relevant content as per exam guidelines. Remember, unrelated content may not only dilute your argument but also affect the essay's length requirements negatively.

**3. Grammar, Usage, and Style:**
There are several grammatical and stylistic issues to address:
- Avoid run-on sentences by breaking down complex ideas into simpler sentences. This will also help in clarifying your arguments.
- Pay attention to conjunction usage. Starting sentences with "but" when there is no preceding idea to contrast can disrupt flow and clarity.
- Look out for spelling and word choice errors ("stuffs" should be "stuff", "learnt" is more commonly "learned" in American English, etc.).
- Enhance readability by avoiding overly long sentences and ensuring proper punctuation.

**4. Descriptive and Clear Arguments:**
Your examples, like the greeting customs in India, are good but need to be further explored and connected back to your main argument. Provide more detailed explanations on why not adopting local behavior might be justified, and how this aligns with your overall thesis. 

**5. Conclusion:**
Your conclusion should succinctly mirror your introduction, restating your position and summarizing the key reasons supporting your viewpoint. Aim for 3-5 sentences that encapsulate your thesis and the arguments presented without introducing new information.

Improving on these elements can significantly enhance the coherence, persuasiveness, and readability of your essay. Remember, the goal is to present a well-structured argument that clearly conveys your stance on the topic.

prompt: IELTS Task 2: the same organisation or different organisations?
essay:
Task 2: Some people work for the same organization all their working life. Others think that it is better to work for different organizations. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion. 
 My answer: 
 It is true that the question of whether to work for the same organization the whole working life or work for different organizations remains a source of controversy in the labor market. While a number of people believe that individuals should work for an organization merely, I would argue that it is better to become a part of some companies. 
 On the one hand, it is believed that working in just only cooperation can bring several positive results to this problem for some justifications. Firstly, labors might have a good chance to understand clearly and dig deep about the operation of their company. As a result, they can enable company's operation to operate in a smooth way and restrict a variety of unexpected problems. Secondly, working for a long time can assist people in gaining more promotion opportunities. This would lead to rise of pay and benefits with their seniority. 
 On the other hand, I am in favor of the idea that people should have chances working for some different companies. It is indisputable that they might have more opportunities to choose which working environment is appropriate for them. As a consequence, labors would be fresher and full of energy when they have to work daily. Another compelling reason for the idea is that individuals can think in imaginary ways instead of stereotype when they have already understood clearly about their company. For example, in marketing field where the imagination is encouraged usually, non-experienced labors are still accepted. 
 In conclusion, although both views certainly have some validity, it seems to me that it is better to work for several organizations instead of just only one.
feedback:
The essay presented provides an engaging discussion on whether it's more beneficial to work for one organization throughout one's career or to experience working for different companies. Another issue worth noting is that radiation of cellular phones can take great toll on human health.  As damaging the use of mobile phones seems to be, there are still a variety of advantages we cannot deny. To begin with modern people can stay in touch much more easily than before thanks to this powerful portable device. As if to exemplify, advanced features such as video call and voice messages have enabled us people to communicate conveniently and effectively. Moreover, mobile phones have done wonders for human work. Were mobile phones not to exist, employees would strenuously remember their appointments or deadlines on their own. 
 Given all the above-mentioned, it seems unequivocal that excluding mobile phones from our live is unfeasible. Instead, I advocate mitigating the problems by different ways as well as compartmentalising technology to improve our living standards.
feedback:

3. **Clarity of Point of View:** Your point of view is present but could be made stronger with more explicit statements of your opinion. For instance, after discussing the negative effects, transition to discussing the positives by explicitly stating how these benefits might outweigh the downsides, to prevent jarring jumps between topics.

Finally, to further enhance the readability and impact of your essay, use more specific examples to support your claims. Concrete examples make your position more relatable and convincing.

prompt: TASK 2: it is more important to spend money on roads and motorways than on public transport systems
essay:
Some people think it is more important to spend money on roads and motorways than on public transport systems such as railways and trams. 
 To what extent do you agree or disagree? 
 Whether the focus of funding for refurbishing existing roads or improving public transport has been a hot-debated topic. Some people are of the opinion that it is more necessary to invest in highways than new railways. In my opinion, I wholeheartedly agree with the idea due to the benefits it might bring to citizens' lives and the inconvenience of the public transport counterpart. 
 To begin with, allocating money to renovating existing transportation system will be a straightforward solution to address the emergent problem of vehicular traffic congestion in urban areas. This is because the construction of new roads and overpasses provides alternative routes for drivers. As a result, vehicles will be distributed to different routes leading to the same destinations, thereby improving overall traffic efficiency. Also, when the authorities spend the budget on reconstruction and upgrading roads by removing potholes, it will enhance the commuting experience of local citizens while maintain the comfort of driving their own cars. 
 Some people believe that the introduction and expansion of public transportation systems can also offer the same benefits, such as ease congestion bottenecks, due to the larger capacity of public transport vehicles. However, these public vehicles fail to offer passengers a comfortable experience. For example, train overcrowding at peak times will lead to the similar frustration to the road jams. Besides, over-crowded trains might pose safety issues, such as pickpockets and thieves. Secondly, the proposal of subways and rail systems is believed to cost a larger amount of national budget that not all nations can afford. Compared to works on existing roads, the public transport systems require larger projects due to their complexity and modernity, such as high-speed trams. Therefore, in my view, as a easier and cost effective approach, repairing and contructing existing roads are more recommended. 
 In conclusion, I am inclined to the operation and refurbishment of road infrastructure as this brings straightforward solution to traffic issues and offers a comfortable experience for the traffic participants. Meanwhile, the public transport counterpart seems not ideal due to its high cost and less favorable experience for passengers.
feedback:
The essay provides a clear stance supporting the investment in road infrastructure over public transportation systems, which is a positive aspect as it directly addresses the topic of whether funds should be allocated more to roads and motorways than to public transport. This essay contains several strengths, including the organization of ideas and the inclusion of examples to support arguments. However, there are multiple opportunities for improvement to make the arguments stronger and clearer.

First, the introduction mistakenly suggests there's a debate about the focus of funding between refurbishing roads or improving public transport. Instead, the essay should acknowledge the different perspectives on how funds should be prioritized between road infrastructure and public transport, directly responding to the essay question. Clarifying this will help avoid any confusion and ensure the essay directly addresses the question asked.

Secondly, when stating agreement with an idea, it's essential to be explicit about what that idea is. The phrase "I wholeheartedly agree with the idea" is too vague and does not specify which aspect of the discussion the agreement pertains to. To improve, clearly state that the agreement is with prioritizing funding for roads and motorways over public transportation, making the position more understandable to the reader.

Regarding the body of the essay, while it presents arguments favoring road infrastructure enhancement, it lacks a clear and distinct expression of personal opinion within the argument paragraphs. To strengthen the essay, integrate personal viewpoints more explicitly in these sections. Rather than saving personal perspectives for the conclusion or solely discussing public opinion, weave your analysis and stance throughout the essay, particularly in the body paragraphs.

On a grammatical level, there are minor issues, such as the spelling of "constructing" as "contructing" and the term "hot-debated topic," which would be more correctly phrased as "hotly debated topic." Addressing these errors will enhance the essay's overall clarity and professionalism.

The conclusion effectively summarizes the preference for road infrastructure investment but repeats the need to express personal opinions more robustly earlier in the essay. Conclusions should synthesize the arguments presented, reinforcing the author's stance without introducing new arguments.

In essence, to improve the essay, ensure the topic is directly addressed from the outset, clarify and specify the stance in the introduction, integrate personal opinion throughout the essay, correct minor grammatical errors, and maintain clarity in argumentation. By following these suggestions, the essay can be made more coherent, direct, and persuasive.

5. **Conclusion**: The conclusion does restate the main argument, which is good practice, but it could be more impactful by summarizing the key points made in the essay more clearly. A strong conclusion leaves the reader with a clear understanding of your stance and the reasons behind it.

prompt: Face to face communication will become a thing of the past. Opinion essay.
essay:
There is an ongoing trend that more and more people connect with one another through the online media such as text messaging rather than the actual facial communication. Which leads to some believe that the method of face to face talking would soon be substituted. In this essay, I completely disagree with the statement and will elaborate my reasons as follows. 
 On primary reason to facial communication is still important is that facial expression helps convey its message more effectively. Many public speakers including politicians insist to give speeches in public. They understand that face to face interaction with the audience is the most efficient way to persuade people's beliefs. Texting or videoing would lose the elements of authenticity and integrity since it could be set up beforehand. Therefore, physical interaction is crucial to many people. 
 Furthermore, many serious business meetings are required physical attendance in order to avoid any ambiguity. Since signing an agreement during its conference needs the absolute accuracy, online chatting or messaging would be unacceptable. This is imperative because a contract is a part of the company capitals. When the agreement goes wrong, one company might face negative consequences. 
 Finally, A number of applications support face to face communication. Take Facetime for instance, its software that designed for people to see others' faces during its phoning. With these innovations, people are still using the technique of facial communication. 
 To recapitulate, face to face interaction is still widely used as it helps the skills of storytelling to be credible. Even in the business world, the facial communication aids to reduce errors. Moreover, the technology has also adopted its way of physical communication for commercial use.
feedback:
This essay attempts to argue against the notion that online communication will eventually replace face-to-face interactions. The stance against this substitution is clear throughout the essay, which is a strength. However, there are several areas where improvement is needed to enhance clarity, coherence, and effectiveness.

1. **Response to the Topic**: The essay successfully addresses the topic by arguing for the continued importance of face-to-face communication. This is a strength of the essay. However, the essay would benefit from a more structured approach to directly link examples and arguments to the main thesis.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, or Stylistic Issues**: There are some issues with grammar, such as missing articles ("A primary reason..."), incorrect capitalization ("facial Communication", "Facetime"), and awkward phrases ("...designed for people to see others' faces during its phoning"). Simplify and correct these for clarity and professionalism.

3. **Point of View Clarity**: The author's viewpoint is clear: they believe face-to-face communication remains vital and cannot be fully replaced by online media. This clarity is a positive aspect of the essay.

4. **Arguments and Support**: The essay provides reasons and examples to support the viewpoint, yet it lacks depth. Each paragraph presents a new point but rushes through it without fully developing the idea. For example, mentioning the importance of physical presence in business meetings and public speeches is compelling, but these arguments need further elaboration and concrete examples to be persuasive.

**Specific Feedback for Improvement**:

- **Paragraph Structure**: Aim for more than two sentences per paragraph. A solid paragraph structure includes a topic sentence, a sentence providing reasoning or elaboration, and a concluding sentence or an example. This structure will help develop your arguments more thoroughly.

- **Use of Terms**: Avoid using "facial communication". This term is misleading. Opt for "face-to-face communication" or "in-person interactions" instead. The correct terminology will enhance the essay’s professionalism and clarity.

- **Expanding Ideas**: Try to develop each point fully. After stating an argument, explain why it's important, how it relates to the topic, and provide specific examples. This development ensures your ideas are conveyed clearly and persuasively.

- **Outlining**: Consider outlining your essay before writing it. This process helps organize thoughts and ensures each paragraph effectively supports your argument. An outline might include a point you want to make, why this point is important, and how you will prove it with an example.

Implement these suggestions to improve the structure, clarity, and persuasiveness of your essay. Remember, each point you make should build upon your argument in a clear and logical way. Good luck!

prompt: Preserving friendships with our old friends or finding new friends?
essay:
Friends play a prominent role in our life, so it is pivotal for everyone to have appropriate friends. Apart from that, keep continuing the relationship with old friends is another issue. As far as I am concerned, preserving friendships with our friends is a precious ability to be happy although they would be few. I feel this way for two main reasons, which I will explore in the following essay. 
 To begin with, we could set up a deeper and closer connection with an old friend than with fresh friends. The more a relationship takes time, the more we can know our friends. As a result, you would realize different aspects of the personality of friends, which means you can trust them better. Furthermore, when we build a good perception of our friends, we can predict their reactions certainly. In this regard, we would have a better sense and happier times. For instance, ten years ago I get admission from the university that my old friend, Sam, was there. Even though I found many new friends, my most valuable incidents happened with Sam. Since we know each other completely, we knew what to do to make happy each other. On the contrary, it was hard for me to hang out with fresh friends because I did not know them and consequently could not trust them. 
 Secondly, friends who know each other for a long time care about themselves better. Socialists liken the relationship to investment so that everything we do with our friends would turn back to us. Since people spend their best time with their friends, they expect their friends to give hand them when they get stuck in trouble. In contrast, people do not matter about the friends who do not them well for a long time. My personal example is a compelling example of this. I have a long friendship with my friend, Sam. Thanks to my job and my numerous travel, I find a new friend on every journey. I hang out with them, or I watch a TV show. However, my best and happier time is with Sam, for I think he will be with me for a long time, and we could contribute ourselves to improve the quality of life. 
 In conclusion, in my opinion, the capability of retaining a long relationship with an old friend is more precious and brings about more happiness for us than the ability to make a new friend. This is because a long relationship causes deeper and valuable connections, and aged friends with a long history in friendship care about each other better and more.
feedback:
Your essay effectively argues for the value of maintaining long-term friendships and how they contribute to our social development and happiness. The main position is clear and supported by personal experiences and a broad argument about the quality of these relationships. However, there are several areas where improvement is necessary to enhance the clarity, accuracy, and overall impact of your writing.

1. **Response to the Topic:**
You've addressed the topic by emphasizing the importance of old friends, which aligns well with the prompt. To make your introduction more impactful, consider directly stating your agreement with the prompt before expanding on your reasons. This approach can make your argument clearer from the beginning.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Stylistic Issues:**
- There are some issues with word usage and grammar that need attention. For instance, using "socialists" instead of "social experts" can cause confusion. Socialists are associated with a political ideology, not the study of social relationships.
- Be mindful of tense consistency. Make sure that when you are discussing past events, you consistently use the past tense, and similarly for present and future events.
- Simplify your language to improve readability. Instead of saying "preserve friendships with our friends," you could simply say "keep friends."

3. **Clarity of the Author's Point of View:**
Your viewpoint is clear throughout the essay, which is a strong point. Yet, the structure could be improved to present your arguments more coherently. Starting with a direct statement of agreement with the prompt can help set the stage for your arguments.

4. **Descriptive Arguments:**
Your essay includes descriptive arguments, notably through personal examples. However, refining these examples and connecting them more directly to your main argument will strengthen your essay. For instance, the example of your friend Sam illustrates your point well but try to explicitly connect how this example supports your larger argument about the value of long-term friendships.

**General Feedback:**
- Focus on word choice and ensuring you're using the correct terms for what you intend to communicate. Practicing word exercises could be beneficial.
- Review and study tense usage to ensure your writing is consistent and clear.
- Simplify your language for better readability and to ensure your audience easily understands your arguments.
- Directly stating your agreement with the essay prompt before delving into your reasons can make your argumentation clearer and more forceful.

Your essay demonstrates a thoughtful perspective on the importance of maintaining old friendships. With attention to these areas of improvement, your writing will become clearer, more precise, and more engaging. Keep reflecting on your personal experiences as they provide a compelling basis for your arguments, and work on expressing these insights as clearly as possible.

prompt: Child care from centers or blood relatives
essay:
In modern society, due to the desire to supplement family's current financial base, working-parents family are now becoming predominant. The prevalence of this family configuration leads to the increasing demand for child care. Opinions are divided into whether daycare centers or blood relatives such as elder adults provide better nurturing for children, but it is my firm conviction that the latter's upbringing is the best. 
 On the one hand, childcare centers such as preschools or kindergartens seem appealing to couples who are inundated with dual working due to several reasons. Firstly, thanks to the convenience of these services, working parents save a lot of time; to be more specific, parents no longer need to juggle child care and career; thereby properly concentrating on their paid work. Secondly, daycare centers offer various extracurricular activities such as singing contests, storytelling competitions or weekly picnics, which are ideal opportunities for children to socially interact with people of different ages and genders. These merits contribute greatly to children's soft skills later in their life. 
 on the other hand, I take the view that support from a relative by consanguinity is of tremendous value to the whole family. First, the grandparents' child care is such a balm to financially disadvantaged parents especially those who struggle to accommodate basic needs, not to mention afford their offspring costly care offered by daycare centers. secondly, routes of connecting between the elderly and their descendants, which tends to be rarely seen in modern society, can be easily created. By constantly giving their grandchildren both physical and mental care, the older adults simultaneously befriend and bond with them. This kinship relationship obviously does not exist if the children are care in the center. 
 In conclusion, although it is undeniable that both parents and children benefits a lot from daycare centers, these services do not suit some families with poor socio-economic background and also sometimes minimize the chances to heal the distance between the elderly and the youth.
feedback:
The essay addresses an important and relevant topic in modern society about whether children benefit more from being cared for by daycare centers or blood relatives, such as grandparents. It demonstrates a good understanding of both sides of the argument, outlining the advantages of daycare centers, as well as the benefits of having family members care for children. However, there are several areas where this essay could be improved to make it clearer, more effective, and better aligned with the requirements of an English proficiency test.

1. **Clarity and Response to the Topic**: While the topic is addressed, the introduction alters the original presentation of the prompt by adding an opinion that wasn't required. For a more accurate response, it’s important to directly restate the facts of the prompt without adding personal views or altering its requirements. This will help in avoiding deviation from the prompt, which is essential for a higher Task Achievement score.

2. **Spelling, Grammar, and Style**: The essay is well-written but contains minor errors and inconsistencies. For instance, capitalization is inconsistent at the beginning of sentences, and there's the use of lower-case 'on' in "on the other hand." Additionally, the use of semicolons and commas could be revisited for clarity. Also, consider simplifying complex sentences to ensure the essay is easily understood by readers at all proficiency levels. Correcting these mistakes will improve readability and coherence.

3. **Point of View**: The essay mixes the author's viewpoint with that of the general public's opinions. To improve clarity, keep the explanation of public opinions in the third person and present your opinion distinctly, possibly in its own paragraph. This will clearly separate what some working parents believe from your personal standpoint, making the essay's structure more logical and easier to follow.

4. **Arguments and Supporting Details**: The arguments provided are clear and descriptive, showcasing the advantages and disadvantages of daycare centers and family care, respectively. To enhance this, focus on explicitly using the third person when describing public opinions (“Some working parents believe…” and “Others think…”) before presenting your personal opinion. This approach not only clarifies whose opinion is being discussed but also strengthens your argument by providing a comparison basis. 

5. **Expanding the Discussion**: While the conclusion neatly sums up the essay, consider expanding the final analysis. Discuss more deeply how socio-economic backgrounds might influence parental choices in child care, and perhaps include suggestions for bridging the gap between the benefits offered by daycare and family care. This could enrich the essay with a more detailed examination of the topic.

By focusing on these aspects, the essay can be significantly improved in clarity, coherence, accuracy, and adherence to the task requirements. Keep practicing, and remember to always directly address the prompt, clearly state your point of view, and support it with well-structured arguments.

prompt: Ielts essay on land availability in countryside
essay:
Q: 
 In many places,new homes are needed, but the only space available for building them is in the countryside. Some people believe that it is more important to protect the countryside and not build new homes there 
 What is your opinion? 
 countryside space for new buildings 
 A: 
 It is indeed the fact that the requirements to build new homes are posing serious threat to the available land in the countryside. Few people that argue that it is of utmost importance to protect the countryside land due to construction of new homes. Whereas, others hold an opposite opinion. I second my outlook with the former argument of supporting the idea of protecting the land in the countryside and this essay has been addressed accordingly. 
 Due to urbanisation, people are migrating from rural areas to urban areas which poses additional pressure on the available land. To cater the need, people are chopping down trees in the countryside due to the space available there. This leads to deforestation and a drastic increase in pollution because of the non-availability of trees. To be more precise, Delhi's air pollution levels had increased to such an extent that people suffering from asthma could not breathe in and were admitted to the local hospitals. Not only this, construction of buildings in the countryside would destroy the natural habitat which ultimately leads to increase in the number of homeless animals. Moreover, increase in population will put a tremendous pressure on the groundwater levels also. To exemplify, in Bengaluru the groundwater level has gone down to 2000 feet and will lead to great water crisis in future. And hence, countryside land should not be used to construct buildings. 
 On the contrary, few people support the idea of building more homes in the countryside. The primary reason behind this thought is that there is an increase in the number of homeless people. Due to which, people are forced to stay on the streets which give birth to unhygienic surroundings. And hence, to escape unhygienic conditions people prefer to construct buildings on the available land. 
 In conclusion, it is clear that if the countryside space will be used to construct buildings then it will have devastating consequences on the environment as well as on the flora and fauna. And hence, people should explore alternate solutions rather then destroying natural habitats exisiting in the countryside for constructing new houses.
feedback:
The essay explores a significant topic—whether the need for new homes justifies building in the countryside despite environmental concerns. There's a clear stance in favor of protecting countryside land, which answers the prompt effectively. The primary point of view is consistently maintained throughout, emphasizing the importance of preserving natural habitats and addressing the consequences of urbanization. However, to make this essay stronger, here are several areas to consider improving:

1. **Introduction:** The opening paragraph should serve as a more explicit foundation for the essay. Begin by paraphrasing the prompt to demonstrate understanding and restate the issue briefly, including why it's a topic of discussion. This should lead to a thesis statement that clearly outlines your position. This approach helps improve clarity and sets a strong precedent for the rest of the essay.

2. **Development of Ideas:** Each paragraph in the body of the essay should start with a topic sentence that introduces the main idea you will discuss. Follow this with specific details, examples, or explanations to fully develop your argument. This method ensures each paragraph is well-structured and focused on a single aspect of your argument, making your essay more persuasive and easier to follow.

3. **Concluding Paragraph:** The conclusion needs to be a succinct summary that reflects upon the arguments made. Start by restating the topic and your thesis in new terms. prompt: IELTS 2: Learning everything by remembering related facts to achieve a success in studying
essay:
To what extent do you agree or disagree with this statement? 
 Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. 
 Some people hold an opinion that the most vital method to achieve the success in studying is learning everything by remembering related facts. From my perspective, I immensely disconcur with this point of view. 
 First and foremost, education is a process, people will forget knowledge in long term when merely memorizing facts. A survey conducted demonstrates that people have the ability of keeping knowledge in their mind in a certain period of time for around 5 years. Afterward they have tendency to forget those things and leave the rooms to remember current facts. Admittedly, students who learn facts by rote before exams cannot complete their test efficiently because it is difficult to remember everything permanently. 
 Secondly, remembering facts turns out to be an adverse effect in learning when people cannot comprehend those facts. That is to say, people will hardly utilize those facts they only memorized without understanding to apply them in practice. Therefore they cannot be successful when being educated to merely learn something by heart, whereas they must be encouraged to spend time learning facts and arranging them in a logical system over and over. For instance, learning history is never easy if people just keep numbers and facts in their mind, on the top of that, they ought to explain the reason why those facts happens and their significance to the history. 
 In conclusion, I strongly disapprove that people will be successful in studying by learning facts when not understanding the core of the information because education is an extremely sophisticated process.

prompt: IELTS Writing Task 2 Online meetings or offline meetings for teenagers?

 Many adolescents now choose to communicate via the Internet rather than have face-to-face meetings. This essay gives my opinion why this is happening and suggests some methods to promote the socialization in real life among teenagers. 
 Interacting with other people in the internet is preferable because online conversations do remove the distance barrier and encourage the activeness of teenagers. Virtual friends can chat and connect to others from different regions of the country, and even other nations. For example, a teenager tends to make friends with foreigners to improve his or her language skills as well as cultural understanding of other territories. In addition, some people have difficulty socializing in person, so texting is a better way of communication for them. They no longer feel shy or embarrassed to start a conversation with strangers of their age. These two reasons have made virtual interaction more popular than ever. 
 It is of significance that teenagers should be more involved in face-to-face meetings by two methods. First, parental guidance and advices are needed to acknowledge their children that true friendship can not be built without the communication and experience of ups and downs together in real life. Meeting friends in person and participating in favorite activities in common such as drawing, and doing sports help to strengthen the bond in friendship. Last but not least, schools should open clubs or students' communities so that people with similar interest can get to know and assist each other in school life and real life. 
 In conclusion, virtual communication is getting its popularity due to the removal of distance and embarrassment. However, offline meetings are crucial to be motivated for teenagers via the help of parents and schools.

prompt: Getting promotions is one of the biggest motivators for hard work in the modern workplace.
essay:

 Topic

 Why are people so driven to receive promotions? 
 What other factors motivate people to work hard? 
 My essay

As the cost of expenditure is upsurging, promotion can be such a promising source of income that people can satisfy their needs without falling into a financial crisis. This in turn would aid them to guarantee a better life. Greater social status can be another factor which drives people towards job promotions. With the change to a higher position in the organization, the society's respect towards a person can be positively enhanced. 
 Besides promotion, setting realistic targets can exert a remarkable influence on work effort. Supervisors may encounter difficulties in assessing and monitoring productivity without an objective in mind. Therefore, clear goals can give a reference point and make it easier to keep staff on an united track . Furthermore, people also work hard in order to broaden their knowledge just from the implementation of several simple projects in the workplace, which supplements them with a strong foundation for their future career. 
 To conclude, some people are working with their greatest enthusiasm in the hope of getting promoted. However, there are many other factors having the same influence on work ethic as well.

6. **Conclusion:**

In summary, focusing on directly answering the essay prompt, structuring your paragraphs with clear topic sentences, developing your arguments with more detail and examples, simplifying your language for clarity, and refining grammar usage will greatly enhance your essay. Keep these points in mind for your next writing task to create more coherent, focused, and compelling essays.

However, there are several areas where the essay could be improved to enhance clarity and relevance to potential essay prompts. First and foremost, the essay prompt or question to which this response is meant to address is not specified. It's crucial for the essay to directly respond to a specific question or topic. From the writing perspective, be mindful of punctuation and structure to improve readability. In several instances, there is a lack of space after punctuation marks, such as "eat .So". Proper spacing and punctuation are essential for clear communication. Also, consider varying sentence structure to create a more engaging narrative flow. While the description is detailed, incorporating more varied sentence lengths and constructions can enhance the storytelling aspect.

The mention of an image and discussions around the format or expectations of the essay suggests some confusion. It is better to clarify the essay’s instructions and requirements before beginning to write. This will ensure that your essay meets the expectations and clearly addresses the prompt.

prompt: WRITING TASK 2: IN MANY COUNTRIES AROUND THE WORLD, LIFE EXPECTANCY IS INCREASING
essay:
There is evidence that the increase in life expectancy has appeared globally. Whilst a variety of drawbacks of this trend are witnessed, I truly believe that the benefits may outweigh them. 
 There are 2 main disadvantages can be seen in this tendency. The more noticeable one is the pressure on social care grows. The governments in many developing countries are less likely to cope with the issue that more people claim pension benefits, nor the needs of an ageing population. By way of example, Cambodia or the Phillippines, may feel struggle to meet an ever increasing number of retired workers and pension commitments, due to the greater funding demands. Another problem is that increased longevity can negatively affect the balance between the fertility and mortality rates. For instance, Japan are now facing a higher burden on the shrinking working population. 
 Take a look on the upside, the growth in life expectancy encounters various positive consequences. Firstly, people assume that this trend can boost human companionship among different generations. The much time the retired have with their family, the more meaningful memories can be built. Besides that, life expectancy at birth measures health status across all age groups. Being able to predict how populations will age has enormous implications for the planning and provision of services and support. As an effect, the authorities can plan decades ahead and make the quality of life more better and better. 
 To sum up, increased longevity in many societies have both pros and cons. Whereas the negative side of this trend mostly relates to general social matters, the postive one are mostly with respect to individuals, which can gradually justify those obstacles. 
 Dear friend who is going to read and evaluate my essay, I am an amateur and still lack lots of skills in writing 
 Please feel free to point out my mistakes and give me appropriate ways to fix it.
feedback:
The essay provides a thoughtful exploration of the effects of increased life expectancy, addressing both potential disadvantages and benefits. However, there are several areas that could be improved to enhance clarity, coherence, and adherence to the essay prompt's requirements.

First, it's essential to focus strictly on what the essay topic asks for. The initial statement expressing a personal belief that the benefits may outweigh the disadvantages might not be entirely appropriate for this type of essay. The task is to discuss advantages and disadvantages, not to evaluate them personally. Staying neutral and focusing on presenting each point of view equally will help maintain the objective tone expected in such discussions.

Regarding the structure and flow of the essay, more effective transition phrases could significantly improve readability and coherence. The essay sometimes jumps from one idea to another without clear connections, making it harder for readers to follow your arguments. To enhance cohesion between paragraphs and within them, consider using phrases that clearly link your ideas, such as "Furthermore," "In contrast," or "Similarly." This will not only make your essay easier to read but also show a higher level of writing skill.

Additionally, while both disadvantages and advantages of increased life expectancy are mentioned, there is a noticeable difference in how each is developed. Each point, whether an advantage or a disadvantage, needs to be explored with equal depth and detail. This balance ensures that all parts of the essay are well-supported and that your discussion appears thorough and unbiased.

In terms of spelling, grammar, and stylistic issues, it's crucial to pay attention to details such as the correct use of articles ("the Philippines" instead of "the Phillippines"), verb agreement ("Japan is" instead of "Japan are"), and pluralization ("positive ones" instead of "postive one"). Also, working on sentence variety and avoiding repetitions could make the text more engaging.

Finally, the conclusion could be strengthened by summarizing the key points more effectively without introducing new ideas or opinions. A stronger, more neutral conclusion would reinforce the essay's structure and argumentation.

Overall, the essay demonstrates a good understanding of the topic but can significantly benefit from clearer organization, more neutral tone, and careful attention to language details. Implementing these suggestions will not only improve this essay but also enhance writing skills for future assignments.

prompt: IELTS TASK 2: Individual sports or team sports is more beneficial? Discuss and give your opinions
essay:
Whether participating in team sports like football or individual sports such as tennis or swimming is a major topic of concern in today's world. While some people believe that playing individual sports is better, there are more persuasive reasons why people should also spend time playing team sports in everyday life. 
 On the one hand, there are some reasons to believe that taking time to play solo sports provides positive aspects. The primary reason is that it helps individuals to enhance their personal skills, not only helping them to manage emotions but also creating the ability to cope with stress. As a matter of fact, people tend to not rely on other support, in order to learn how to cultivate and maximize personal capacities in sports. Gymnastics, for example, each person is able to organize the schedule and be active in their daily practice, rather than depend on others and keep delaying the tasks. Another significant reason is that individual sports are good ideas for people who are interested in challenging activities, which enhance specific skills in setting goals and achieving their personal bests. 
 On the other hand, there is compelling evidence that each individual should assume the benefits of participating in sports that are played in teams. This is mainly because it provides opportunities to develop interpersonal skills such as communication and teamwork in social life. In other words, this helps people to build their confidence and self-esteem at the workplace or at school to achieve the best performance and tends to be highly recommended for a promotion in a company. In addition to this, team sports are able to create potential opportunities to develop a sense of unity and establish long-term relationships among their friends. For instance, playing in a football team makes them feel a part of something, after attending various competitions people could learn from their failures, realize their importance as a member of the team, and also reduce anxiety to create a positive environment in the game. 
 In conclusion, although it is often believed that people should take part in individual sports, there are stronger reasons why participating in team sports is also necessary. It is recommended that everyone should play sports that are most interesting to them, all sports are advantageous for people's mental and physical health in daily lives.
feedback:
The essay effectively restates the prompt and outlines a comparison between team and individual sports, addressing the main topic directly. However, the structure and development of arguments could be improved to make the essay stronger and clearer.

Firstly, focusing on a single, well-developed reason in each paragraph would enhance the clarity and impact of your arguments. Attempting to cover multiple reasons without adequately exploring each can dilute the effectiveness of your points. For instance, when discussing the benefits of individual sports, concentrating on how it enhances personal skills with more detailed examples and explanations would be more persuasive than briefly mentioning several benefits. Similarly, for team sports, expanding on the development of interpersonal skills with more depth would strengthen your argument.

The essay tends to convey opinions from a personal perspective, which might make it seem subjective. While sharing personal views is valuable, incorporating a broader perspective and presenting opinions as more universally applicable could make your arguments more compelling. This approach would shift the focus from what you believe to a more generalized understanding of the subject, thus making your arguments more relatable and persuasive to a wider audience.

Moreover, the recommendation at the end of the essay, suggesting that everyone should choose the sport they find most interesting, deviates from the main discussion of comparing team and individual sports. Though well-intentioned, sticking closely to the essay topic and developing your arguments within that framework would ensure coherence and relevance throughout your essay.

In summary, your essay benefits from a clear topic response and an attempt to balance the discussion between team and individual sports. To further improve, consider narrowing down your points to the most compelling arguments and offering more universal perspectives. This approach will not only strengthen your essay but will also make it more engaging and persuasive to your readers. Remember to stay closely aligned with the prompt and focus on developing your ideas fully for each point you choose to discuss.

prompt: Task 2 - what children watch influences their behaviors or it is the amount of time they spend.
essay:
People have differing views about what affects children's behaviors most. While some people consider that it is the amount of time children spend watching television, I would argue that it is the content of the programs they watch. 
 On the one hand, there are various reasons why children's behaviors are impacted by the amount of time they spend sitting in front of the television. Firstly, if children watch too much TV, they will develop a habit of watching and eventually become addicted to TV for entertainment. This might lead to the scenario where children spend all the day with the TV, neglect outdoor activities and trap themselves in a sedentary lifestyle. Secondly, those who spend all the time watching TV may isolate themselves from the people around them. As a result, they will have less interaction and therefore, do not develop any social skills that are considered essential for their lives. 
 On the other hand, while viewing time may harm preschoolers to a certain extent, I still believe that the programs' content influences their actions most. The main reason is that children still have not developed the awareness enough to distinguish between the right and the wrong. If they are exposed to counter-educational programs, they will have some misconceptions and inappropriate behaviors, which will result in the tendency that children imitate what they are seen on the screen. For instance, violent scenes on TV shows show children a bad example of manners and affect their thoughts as well as their behaviors when they grow up. 
 In conclusion, although the amount of time preschoolers spend viewing TV programs may have some effect on children's actions, I believe what they watch influences them most.
feedback:
This essay addresses the topic of what primarily affects children's behaviors, comparing the impact of the amount of television watched to the content of what is watched. The essay makes a clear argument that the content of television programs has a more significant impact on children's behaviors than just the amount of time they spend watching TV, showcasing a strong point of view. 

However, to improve the essay and fully address the topic, it's important to articulate both public viewpoints as well as your own in a more defined structure. Each perspective or opinion should be explored in dedicated paragraphs. First, introduce and explain the public opinion on how the amount of time spent watching TV affects children's behavior. Then, present and discuss the second public viewpoint that emphasizes the influence of program content on children's behavior. Following these sections, a separate paragraph should present your opinion, contrasting or agreeing with these viewpoints, ultimately leading to a reasoned conclusion that supports one stance over the other. This approach ensures a balanced discussion and provides a clearer understanding of the different perspectives before introducing your own.

The essay would benefit from minor improvements in spelling, grammar, and style to enhance clarity and readability. Specifically, paying attention to consistent tense usage and sentence structure will greatly improve the overall quality of the writing. For example, ensuring consistency in verb tenses and avoiding repetitive sentence beginnings can make the text more engaging.

Furthermore, while the essay introduces relevant arguments supporting your view, these could be more specific and descriptive. Providing concrete examples or citing studies to back up claims about the effects of television content on children's behavior would strengthen your position. This addition would offer more depth to your arguments and help convince the reader of your perspective.

In conclusion, focusing on a structured comparison of the mentioned viewpoints before presenting your conclusion can make your essay more comprehensive and persuasive. Addressing minor linguistic errors and enriching your arguments with detailed examples or evidence will further enhance the quality of your writing. Following these suggestions will not only align your essay more closely with the prompt's requirements but also improve its overall effectiveness in conveying your message.

prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Parents are the best teachers.
essay:
Parents are always by our sides when we have troubles, share everything with us, and make our lives easier. Although parents are the first teachers in our lives, I don't think they are the best teachers for us. 
 Firstly, our parents sometimes force us to follow their interests and hopes. They want their children to do what they couldn't do in the past and want us to be similar to what they like. Sometimes, they don't let us be the people we want. 
 Secondly, they don't want their children to pass comfort zones. They keep their children in their vision. They don't want their children to be dangerous. Although they know their children can do more, they keep them safe. 
 Parents are important teachers for us, but they aren't always the best teachers. Fortunately, besides our parents, we have a lot of teachers who show us to be better people. We learn from our teachers at school, friends, and even from books and the internet.
feedback:

This structural adjustment helps in laying a solid foundation for the argument, making the essay's direction clearer to the reader.

The use of contractions (e.g., "don't", "can't") is another area of concern. For formal writing, and especially in an English proficiency test context, it is preferable to use full forms ("do not", "cannot") over contractions. This not only elevates the formality of the essay but also demonstrates a better grasp of English sentence construction.

In terms of content and argumentation, while the points made are relevant and provide some insight into the author’s perspective, expanding on these ideas with more detailed examples or explanations could strengthen the essay. Discussing personal experiences or offering more concrete scenarios could enrich the content and engage the reader more effectively.

To enhance the essay further, focus on clear and error-free language use. Paying attention to spelling, grammar, and proper sentence structure is essential for conveying ideas effectively and achieving a high score.

In summary, to improve, focus on expanding the essay to meet the word count requirement, structuring the introduction to include a restatement of the prompt, avoiding contractions for a more formal tone, and providing more detailed arguments to support the viewpoint. Additionally, refining the language for clarity and correctness will greatly benefit the overall quality of the essay.
